words.enDefinition: distribute according to a plan or set apart for a special purpose

examples.en: The tutor allocates twenty minutes of each lesson to free conversation.
examples.zh: 老师给每节课「分配」二十分钟自由对话时间。

examples.en: Council funds are allocated to the library, the pool, and the youth club.
examples.zh: 市政经费被「分配」给图书馆、游泳池和青少年俱乐部。

words.enDefinition: any of various burrowing animals of the family Leporidae having long ears and short tails; some domesticated and raised for pets or food

examples.en: Our neighbours' rabbit escaped again and turned up in our vegetable patch.
examples.zh: 邻居家的「兔子」又逃出来了，结果出现在我们的菜地里。

examples.en: The children fed the rabbit carrot tops through the hutch wire.
examples.zh: 孩子们隔着笼子喂「兔子」胡萝卜缨。

words.enDefinition: piece of cloth used as decoration or to mend or cover a hole

examples.en: Grandmother sewed a bright patch over the hole in my school trousers.
examples.zh: 奶奶在我校裤的破洞上缝了一块鲜艳的「补丁」。

examples.en: He ironed a patch onto the elbow of his favourite jacket.
examples.zh: 他在心爱夹克的肘部熨上一块「补片」。

words.enDefinition: relating to or belonging to the Middle Ages

examples.en: The medieval castle wall still stands above the market square.
examples.zh: 那段「中世纪的」城堡城墙仍然矗立在集市广场上方。

examples.en: They lit the hall with candles for the medieval-themed feast.
examples.zh: 为「中世纪」主题的宴会，他们用蜡烛点亮了大厅。

words.enDefinition: appear like; be similar or bear a likeness to

examples.en: Everyone says the baby resembles her grandfather around the eyes.
examples.zh: 大家都说这孩子的眼睛「长得像」外公。

examples.en: The new library resembles a ship moored at the end of the street.
examples.zh: 新图书馆「形似」一艘停泊在街尾的轮船。

words.enDefinition: pass through

examples.en: The old bridge must undergo a full inspection before spring traffic.
examples.zh: 春季通车前，老桥必须「经受」一次全面检查。

examples.en: She underwent minor surgery on her wrist and recovered quickly.
examples.zh: 她的手腕做了小手术，恢复得很快。

words.enDefinition: the quality of being secluded from the presence or view of others

examples.en: The thick hedge shields us from the road and gives us privacy.
examples.zh: 浓密的树篱挡住马路视线，保住了我们的「隐私」。

examples.en: Respect their privacy and knock before entering the office.
examples.zh: 尊重他人的「隐私」，进办公室前先敲门。

words.enDefinition: shoulder firearm with a long barrel and a rifled bore

examples.en: The old rifle hangs above the fireplace as a family keepsake.
examples.zh: 那支老「步枪」作为传家物挂在壁炉上方。

examples.en: Soldiers clean and oil their rifles every Sunday morning in camp.
examples.zh: 驻营期间，士兵们每周日早上都会保养「步枪」。

words.enDefinition: the act of closing something; the state of being closed

examples.en: The sudden closure of the bridge added twenty minutes to every journey.
examples.zh: 大桥突然「关闭」，每次出行都多了二十分钟。

examples.en: Residents petitioned against the closure of the village's last shop.
examples.zh: 居民们请愿，反对关闭村里最后一家商店。

words.enDefinition: the organization of information according to preset specifications (usually for computer processing)

examples.en: Please send the minutes in the same format as last month's.
examples.zh: 会议记录请按上个月的「格式」发送。

examples.en: The novel was reissued in a pocket-sized format for travellers.
examples.zh: 小说重印时改成了便于携带的口袋「版式」。

words.enDefinition: decreed by or proceeding from a court of justice

examples.en: The judicial review delayed the harbour project by a full year.
examples.zh: 一次「司法」审查使港口工程整整推迟了一年。

examples.en: Judges must keep their judicial decisions free from outside pressure.
examples.zh: 法官必须让「司法」裁决免受外界压力影响。

words.enDefinition: manner of living that reflects the person's values and attitudes

examples.en: Cycling to work became part of her lifestyle after the move.
examples.zh: 搬家之后，骑车上班成了她「生活方式」的一部分。

examples.en: The island lifestyle suits my parents better than the city ever did.
examples.zh: 相比城市，「岛上生活方式」更适合我父母。

words.enDefinition: message that tells the particulars of an act or occurrence or course of events; presented in writing or drama or cinema or as a radio or television program

examples.en: Grandfather tells the flood narrative differently every time we ask.
examples.zh: 每次问起，爷爷对那场洪水的「讲述」都略有不同。

examples.en: The film's narrative jumps between the two sisters' childhoods.
examples.zh: 影片的「叙事」在两姐妹的童年之间来回切换。

words.enDefinition: small number or amount

examples.en: Only a handful of students signed up for the early Latin class.
examples.zh: 只有「少数几个」学生报了清晨的拉丁语课。

examples.en: She grabbed a handful of raisins before the training run.
examples.zh: 训练开跑前，她抓了「一把」葡萄干。

words.enDefinition: the line at which the sky and Earth appear to meet

examples.en: We watched the storm build along the horizon all afternoon.
examples.zh: 整个下午，我们看着风暴在「地平线」上酝酿。

examples.en: Learning to sail opened a new horizon for the retired teacher.
examples.zh: 学帆船为退休教师打开了新的「视野」。

words.enDefinition: of or located in the lower part of a town, or in the business center

examples.en: The bus drops us downtown right beside the farmers' market.
examples.zh: 公交车把我们直接送到「市中心」的农贸市场旁。

examples.en: They moved downtown to be closer to the theatre district.
examples.zh: 他们搬到「市中心」住，离剧院区更近。

words.enDefinition: an event that results in a transformation

examples.en: The conversion of the barn into a studio took eight months.
examples.zh: 把谷仓改建为工作室的「改造」工程花了八个月。

examples.en: The kitchen's conversion to gas heating cut our bills in half.
examples.zh: 厨房改为燃气供暖后，账单省了一半。

words.enDefinition: relating to an empire or its ruler

examples.en: The imperial palace opens its gardens to the public each spring.
examples.zh: 每年春天，「皇室」宫殿向公众开放花园。

examples.en: Imperial coins from that era turn up at every flea market.
examples.zh: 每个跳蚤市场都能翻出那个年代的「帝国」铸币。

words.enDefinition: the act of enrolling

examples.en: Bring two photos and your passport to the registration desk.
examples.zh: 请带两张照片和护照到「登记」处。

examples.en: Registration for the swimming course closes on Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 游泳课程的「报名」周五下午截止。

words.enDefinition: a flat outdoor paved area next to a house or restaurant

examples.en: We eat breakfast on the terrace when the summer mornings are warm.
examples.zh: 夏日清晨暖和时，我们就在「露台」上吃早餐。

examples.en: The restaurant's terrace overlooks the river and the old bridge.
examples.zh: 餐厅的「露台」正对着河流和古桥。

words.enDefinition: to have a view over something from above; to fail to notice

examples.en: The castle tower overlooks the whole valley and the river bend.
examples.zh: 城堡塔楼「俯瞰」整个山谷和河湾。

examples.en: Double-check the address so we don't overlook the small gate.
examples.zh: 再核对一遍地址，免得「漏看」那扇小门。

words.enDefinition: state categorically

examples.en: She calmly asserted her right to see the building plans.
examples.zh: 她沉着地「主张」自己有权查看建筑图纸。

examples.en: The coach asserted that the team's discipline had improved.
examples.zh: 教练「坚称」球队的纪律性已经提升。

words.enDefinition: creation (a new device or process) resulting from study and experimentation

examples.en: The double-decker bread oven was the bakery's greatest innovation.
examples.zh: 双层烤炉是这家面包店最了不起的「创新」。

examples.en: Every innovation in the workshop began as a doodle on the bench.
examples.zh: 车间里的每一项「革新」都始于工作台上的涂鸦。

words.enDefinition: small room on a ship or boat where people sleep

examples.en: We rented a log cabin by the lake for the half-term week.
examples.zh: 假期那一周，我们租了湖边的原木「小木屋」。

examples.en: The ship's cabin was cosy, with two bunks and a tiny window.
examples.zh: 船上的「舱室」很舒适，有两张铺位和一扇小窗。

words.enDefinition: especially; in particular

examples.en: The seminar was useful, notably the session on local archives.
examples.zh: 研讨会很有用，「尤其是」地方档案那一场。

examples.en: Prices rose across the market, notably for butter and cheese.
examples.zh: 集市物价普遍上涨，「尤其」黄油和奶酪涨得明显。

words.enDefinition: medicine or therapy that cures disease or relieve pain

examples.en: Honey and lemon is the remedy my mother swears by for coughs.
examples.zh: 蜂蜜柠檬水是妈妈治咳嗽最信的「偏方」。

examples.en: The chemist recommended a gentle herbal remedy for the baby's rash.
examples.zh: 药剂师推荐了一种温和的草本「药物」，对付婴儿湿疹。

words.enDefinition: coniferous tree

examples.en: A row of tall pines shelters the garden from the north wind.
examples.zh: 一排高大的「松树」为花园挡住了北风。

examples.en: The little cabin smelled of pine needles and yesterday's woodsmoke.
examples.zh: 小木屋里弥漫着「松针」和昨日柴烟的味道。

words.enDefinition: Against; as, John Doe versus Richard Roe; -- chiefly

examples.en: Saturday's final pits the reigning champions versus the youngest squad.
examples.zh: 周六决赛是卫冕冠军「对阵」最年轻的队伍。

examples.en: The debate framed tradition versus progress, and both sides argued well.
examples.zh: 辩题是传统「对」进步，双方都辩得精彩。

words.enDefinition: the male ruler of an empire

examples.en: The emperor's summer residence sits on the hill above the vineyards.
examples.zh: 「皇帝」的夏宫坐落在葡萄园上方的山坡上。

examples.en: Museum guides tell how the last emperor abdicated in that very hall.
examples.zh: 博物馆讲解员说，末代「皇帝」正是在那座大殿里退位的。

words.enDefinition: professional cook

examples.en: The head chef greets every supplier at the market at dawn.
examples.zh: 清晨集市上，主「厨」会亲自招呼每位供货商。

examples.en: Our local chef won a medal for her rosemary lamb stew.
examples.zh: 本地的这位「厨师」凭迷迭香炖羊肉赢得了一枚奖章。

words.enDefinition: a broad smile in which the teeth are visible

examples.en: A wide grin spread across his face when the parcel arrived.
examples.zh: 包裹一到，他脸上就绽开了大大的「露齿笑」。

examples.en: She hid a grin behind her hand as the puppy stole the sock.
examples.zh: 小狗叼走袜子时，她用手掩着「咧嘴笑」。

words.enDefinition: show or affirm to be just and legitimate

examples.en: The clinic checks that every charity caller is legitimate before opening the door.
examples.zh: 开门前，诊所会先核实来电募捐者是否「正当合法」。

examples.en: He made a legitimate claim to the family's old orchard tools.
examples.zh: 对家中旧果园工具，他提出了「正当的」所有权主张。

words.enDefinition: in a way that is appropriate to the situation or information available

examples.en: The forecast changed, so we packed the tent accordingly.
examples.zh: 天气预报变了，我们据此「相应地」收拾了帐篷。

examples.en: Sort the letters by district and label the boxes accordingly.
examples.zh: 按街区把信件分好，并「相应地」给箱子贴上标签。

words.enDefinition: a group of similar things or people gathered closely together

examples.en: A cluster of mushrooms appeared under the oak after the rain.
examples.zh: 雨后橡树下冒出一「簇」蘑菇。

examples.en: Tourists quickly formed a cluster around the street violinist.
examples.zh: 游客们很快在街头小提琴手周围聚成一「团」。

words.enDefinition: show in, or as in, a picture

examples.en: The mural depicts the harbour as it looked a century ago.
examples.zh: 这幅壁画「描绘」了港口一个世纪前的样子。

examples.en: Old tapestries depict farmers bringing the harvest to the abbey gates.
examples.zh: 古代挂毯「描绘」农民把收成送到修道院门口的情景。

words.enDefinition: person whose occupation is teaching

examples.en: The swimming instructor counts every stroke aloud from the poolside.
examples.zh: 游泳「教练」在池边大声数着每一个划水动作。

examples.en: Our driving instructor insists on checking the mirrors before starting.
examples.zh: 我们的驾「教练」坚持起步前先看后视镜。

words.enDefinition: lacking the requisite qualities or resources to meet a task

examples.en: The inadequate lighting in the stairwell caused several stumbles.
examples.zh: 楼梯间「不足的」照明让人摔了好几跤。

examples.en: Her inadequate notes made the revision week far harder.
examples.zh: 笔记「不充分」，让复习那一周难上加难。

words.enDefinition: to invent or plan something cleverly

examples.en: The neighbours devised a fair rota for walking the shared dog.
examples.zh: 邻居们「设计」了一张公平的遛狗轮值表。

examples.en: She devised a simple code so the children could share secrets.
examples.zh: 她「设计」了一套简单暗号，让孩子们能分享秘密。

words.enDefinition: to match or be in agreement with something

examples.en: The numbered keys correspond to the labelled hooks by the door.
examples.zh: 编号钥匙与门旁挂钩的标签一一「对应」。

examples.en: We correspond by letter because he loves fountain pens and stamps.
examples.zh: 我们靠写信「来往」，因为他喜欢钢笔和邮票。

words.enDefinition: the likelihood of a thing occurring rather than not occurring

examples.en: The odds of catching the last ferry improve if you cycle.
examples.zh: 骑车去的话，赶上末班轮渡的「几率」会更大。

examples.en: Against all odds, the little bookshop survived three recessions.
examples.zh: 「尽管希望渺茫」，那家小书店还是挺过了三次经济衰退。

words.enDefinition: to change something slightly, especially to improve it

examples.en: We modified the recipe slightly by using olive oil instead of butter.
examples.zh: 我们把食谱稍作「修改」，用橄榄油代替黄油。

examples.en: The plan was modified after the neighbours raised concerns about parking.
examples.zh: 邻居们提出停车顾虑后，方案作了「修改」。

words.enDefinition: place of worship that has its own altar

examples.en: The village chapel seats forty people and rings a small bell.
examples.zh: 村里的「小教堂」可容纳四十人，还挂着一口小钟。

examples.en: They were married in the stone chapel on the cliff road.
examples.zh: 他们在崖边路上的石头「礼拜堂」结的婚。

words.enDefinition: consistent with or based on or using reason

examples.en: Let's make a rational decision about the car instead of an emotional one.
examples.zh: 关于这辆车，我们做个「理性的」决定，别感情用事。

examples.en: There is a rational explanation for the lights going out at midnight.
examples.zh: 午夜熄灯其实有一种「合理的」解释。

words.enDefinition: an abstraction belonging to or characteristic of an entity

examples.en: Patience is her best attribute as a primary school teacher.
examples.zh: 「耐心」是她作为小学老师最大的「特质」。

examples.en: The advert lists every attribute of the used caravan, honestly and otherwise.
examples.zh: 广告把这款二手房车的各项「特性」都列了出来，如实得很。

words.enDefinition: measured portion of medicine taken at any one time

examples.en: The pharmacist measured the exact dose of medicine into a spoon.
examples.zh: 药剂师把精确的「剂量」量进小勺里。

examples.en: Never double the dose if you forget the morning tablet.
examples.zh: 如果忘了吃早上的药片，也「切勿」加倍「剂量」。

words.enDefinition: container that is usually woven and has handles

examples.en: She carried the shopping basket through the Saturday vegetable stalls.
examples.zh: 她提着购物「篮」穿过周六的蔬菜摊。

examples.en: The cat sleeps in the wicker basket beside the radiator.
examples.zh: 猫咪睡在暖气片旁的柳条「篮子」里。

words.enDefinition: long fixed look

examples.en: The child's steady gaze made the street mime lose his place.
examples.zh: 孩子「目不转睛的注视」，让街头哑剧演员都乱了阵脚。

examples.en: She followed his gaze to the old lighthouse on the point.
examples.zh: 她顺着他「凝视」的方向望向海角的老灯塔。

words.enDefinition: portray in words

examples.en: The actor portrays the young postman with warmth and humour.
examples.zh: 这位演员「刻画」年轻邮递员时充满温情与幽默。

examples.en: Newspapers portrayed the strike as a crisis, though locals disagreed.
examples.zh: 报纸把罢工「描绘成」危机，当地人却不以为然。

words.enDefinition: special loved one

examples.en: Come in, darling, the soup is still hot on the stove.
examples.zh: 进来吧，「亲爱的」，汤还在炉子上温着呢。

examples.en: The old lady calls every child in the street her darling.
examples.zh: 老太太把街上的每个孩子都称作「心肝宝贝」。

words.enDefinition: mental representation of some haunting experience

examples.en: The old inn claims a friendly ghost walks the top corridor.
examples.zh: 那家老客栈声称有个「幽灵」常在顶层走廊游荡。

examples.en: My brother insists the cold spot in the pantry is a ghost.
examples.zh: 哥哥坚持说，食品储藏室里那块阴冷处是「鬼魂」作祟。

words.enDefinition: small island

examples.en: The little isle can only be reached at low tide.
examples.zh: 那座「小岛」只有在退潮时才能登上。

examples.en: Legends say a saint once lived alone on the isle.
examples.zh: 传说一位圣人曾独自住在那座「小岛」上。

words.enDefinition: the underside of footwear or a golf club

examples.en: The cobbler stitched a new leather sole onto my walking boots.
examples.zh: 修鞋匠给我的徒步靴换缝了新的皮革「鞋底」。

examples.en: His soles were stained yellow from cutting across the fresh field.
examples.zh: 抄近路穿过新刈的草场，他的「脚底」都染黄了。

words.enDefinition: any amazing or wonderful occurrence

examples.en: Finding her wedding ring in the compost was a small miracle.
examples.zh: 在堆肥里找到婚戒，真是个小小的「奇迹」。

examples.en: The doctors called his recovery a miracle after such a fall.
examples.zh: 摔成那样还能康复，医生们称之为「奇迹」。

words.enDefinition: giving satisfaction

examples.en: The plumber's patch was satisfactory, though we will replace the pipe in spring.
examples.zh: 水管工的修补「还过得去」，不过开春我们还是要把管子换掉。

examples.en: The manager asked if the room temperature was satisfactory for everyone.
examples.zh: 经理问室温是否让每个人都「满意」。

words.enDefinition: of a feature that helps to distinguish a person or thing

examples.en: Her distinctive laugh carries all the way across the workshop.
examples.zh: 她那「独特的」笑声能一路传到整个车间。

examples.en: The bakery's distinctive smell of cinnamon reaches the school gate.
examples.zh: 面包店「独特的」肉桂香气一直飘到校门口。

words.enDefinition: found in the ordinary course of events

examples.en: These everyday plates go in the dishwasher without any fuss.
examples.zh: 这些「日常用的」盘子直接放进洗碗机即可。

examples.en: The diary records her everyday struggles with the bus timetable.
examples.zh: 日记记录了她「每天」与公交时刻表较劲的琐碎。

words.enDefinition: spiritual being attendant upon God

examples.en: Grandmother keeps a little carved angel on the kitchen windowsill.
examples.zh: 奶奶在厨房窗台上摆着一尊小木雕「天使」。

examples.en: The nurse who stayed past her shift was our angel that night.
examples.zh: 那晚多留了班的护士就像我们的「天使」。

words.enDefinition: despite anything to the contrary (usually following a concession)

examples.en: The hike was exhausting; nonetheless, everyone signed up for next month.
examples.zh: 这次远足累坏了人；「尽管如此」，大家还是报了下个月的。

examples.en: The evidence was thin; the judge nonetheless granted the extension.
examples.zh: 证据虽薄，法官「仍然」批准了延期。

words.enDefinition: subject to legal action

examples.en: Drivers are liable for any damage caused while the car is borrowed.
examples.zh: 车子借出期间，司机须对一切损坏「承担法律责任」。

examples.en: The old river wall is liable to flood after two days of rain.
examples.zh: 连下两天雨后，老河堤「容易」漫水。

words.enDefinition: express greetings upon meeting someone

examples.en: The doorman greets every guest by name at the winter fair.
examples.zh: 冬季集市上，门童「问候」每位客人时都能叫出名字。

examples.en: Neighbours greet each other with a nod and the weather.
examples.zh: 邻居们碰面时「打个招呼」，聊聊天气。

words.enDefinition: bedding that keeps a person warm in bed

examples.en: Grandmother knitted a thick blanket for the baby's cot.
examples.zh: 奶奶为婴儿床织了一条厚厚的「毯子」。

examples.en: Frost covered the fields like a white blanket before sunrise.
examples.zh: 日出前，霜像白色的「毯子」一样盖住了田野。

words.enDefinition: to a complete degree or to the full or entire extent (`whole' is often used informally for `wholly')

examples.en: The recipe is wholly vegetarian, without any fish stock.
examples.zh: 这道菜谱「完全」是素的，一点鱼汤都不放。

examples.en: I am not wholly convinced the shortcut saves any time.
examples.zh: 我并「不完全」相信抄近路真能省时间。

words.enDefinition: to cause to become; to give or provide

examples.en: The witness rendered great help by describing the van's number plate.
examples.zh: 目击者描述了面包车的车牌，提供了很大「帮助」。

examples.en: The storm rendered the cliff path impassable for a week.
examples.zh: 风暴使崖边小路一周都「无法通行」。

words.enDefinition: agreement in the judgment or opinion reached by a group as a whole

examples.en: After two meetings, the residents reached a consensus on the roof colour.
examples.zh: 开了两次会后，居民们就屋顶颜色达成了「共识」。

examples.en: There is a general consensus that the market should start earlier.
examples.zh: 大家「一致认为」，集市应该提早开张。

words.enDefinition: relating to a colony or the period when a country had colonies

examples.en: The colonial courthouse now houses the town's little history museum.
examples.zh: 那座「殖民时期的」法院大楼如今是镇上的小型历史博物馆。

examples.en: Colonial administrators mapped the coast, though they never settled here.
examples.zh: 「殖民」官员曾绘制过海岸地图，却从未在此定居。

words.enDefinition: evidence that helps to solve a problem

examples.en: The muddy boot prints were the first clue in the missing cat case.
examples.zh: 泥泞的靴印是寻猫案的第一条「线索」。

examples.en: The last clue of the treasure hunt led to the old bicycle shed.
examples.zh: 寻宝游戏的最后一条「线索」指向旧自行车棚。

words.enDefinition: the quality of being intricate and compounded

examples.en: The tax form's complexity puts off most first-time applicants.
examples.zh: 税表的「复杂」让多数初次申报的人望而却步。

examples.en: He explained the complexity of the family feud in three sentences.
examples.zh: 他用三句话讲清了这场家族恩怨的「复杂」所在。

words.enDefinition: concerned with religion or religious purposes

examples.en: The oak by the spring is sacred to the older villagers.
examples.zh: 泉眼旁的橡树在年长村民心中是「神圣的」。

examples.en: They consider the first catch of the season a sacred offering.
examples.zh: 他们把本季第一网渔获视作「神圣的」供奉。

words.enDefinition: piece broken off or cut off of something else

examples.en: She taped the fragment of the old map into her notebook.
examples.zh: 她把那张古地图的「碎片」贴进了笔记本。

examples.en: Archaeologists found a pottery fragment beneath the chapel floor.
examples.zh: 考古学家在礼拜堂地板下发现了一块陶器「残片」。

words.enDefinition: a soft, low, continuous sound or speech

examples.en: A murmur of agreement went quietly round the long table.
examples.zh: 长桌旁响起一片低声「附和」。

examples.en: She heard the murmur of the stream all night from the tent.
examples.zh: 帐篷里整夜都能听到溪水的「潺潺低语」。

words.enDefinition: complete and total; also very steep

examples.en: It was sheer luck that the ladder leaned against the solid wall.
examples.zh: 梯子恰好靠在结实的墙上，纯属「十足的」运气。

examples.en: The path climbs the sheer face of the rock by iron rungs.
examples.zh: 小路靠铁蹬沿「陡峭的」岩壁攀上崖顶。

words.enDefinition: the property of something that is great in magnitude

examples.en: Move the fridge carefully; its bulk makes narrow doorways tricky.
examples.zh: 搬冰箱要小心，它「体积大」，窄门不好过。

examples.en: The bulk of the team arrives by the early bus.
examples.zh: 队里的「大多数人」都搭早班车到。

words.enDefinition: the condition of being essential or indispensable

examples.en: A good torch is a necessity when the power line fails.
examples.zh: 停电时，一把好手电是「必需品」。

examples.en: There is no necessity to buy the expensive brand; the basic one works.
examples.zh: 没有「必要」买贵的那款，基础款就够用了。

words.enDefinition: a long, low seat for two or more people

examples.en: The cat has claimed the sunny end of the couch.
examples.zh: 猫咪已经霸占了「沙发」向阳的那一头。

examples.en: We squeezed the new couch through the doorway by turning it sideways.
examples.zh: 我们把新「沙发」侧着才挤进门。

words.enDefinition: limited to a particular person, group, or organisation

examples.en: The bakery keeps an exclusive recipe that even the apprentices never see.
examples.zh: 那份「独家」配方连学徒都从未见过。

examples.en: The bay is exclusive to members on summer weekends.
examples.zh: 夏季周末，这片海湾「专供」会员使用。

words.enDefinition: story about mythical or supernatural beings or events

examples.en: Local legend says the well never runs dry, even in drought.
examples.zh: 当地「传说」这口井大旱之年也不干涸。

examples.en: My grandfather is a legend at the bowls club for his lucky throw.
examples.zh: 爷爷在草地滚球俱乐部是位「传奇人物」，全凭他那一手幸运投掷。

words.enDefinition: in the stage between childhood and adulthood; typical of teenagers

examples.en: The adolescent years are easier with a shared family dinner table.
examples.zh: 一家人同桌吃晚饭，孩子能更平稳地度过「青春期」。

examples.en: The clinic runs a free evening for adolescent footballers each month.
examples.zh: 诊所每月为「青少年」球员开设一次免费门诊夜。

words.enDefinition: large gregarious predatory feline of Africa and India having a tawny coat with a shaggy mane in the male

examples.en: The stone lion by the library steps has a polished nose from luck.
examples.zh: 图书馆台阶旁的石「狮子」鼻子被摸得发亮，都说沾好运。

examples.en: The children's book shows a lion who is afraid of mice.
examples.zh: 那本童书画的是一头怕老鼠的「狮子」。

words.enDefinition: person or device that receives something; in insolvency, an official who takes control of assets

examples.en: The cordless receiver on the kitchen wall has gone quiet again.
examples.zh: 厨房墙上的无绳「听筒」又没声了。

examples.en: Lift the receiver gently; the hook is loose on this old phone.
examples.zh: 轻一点拿「听筒」，这部老电话的挂钩松了。

words.enDefinition: any customary observance or practice

examples.en: Sunday pancakes remain a small ritual in our busy kitchen.
examples.zh: 周日煎饼是我们忙碌厨房里一项小小的「仪式」。

examples.en: The nightly dog walk has become a ritual the whole street recognises.
examples.zh: 每晚遛狗已成「惯例」，整条街都认得这一幕。

words.enDefinition: provide with something desired or needed

examples.en: The guest room can accommodate four cousins during the reunion.
examples.zh: 团聚时，客房能「容纳」四位表亲住下。

examples.en: The restaurant accommodates wheelchair users with a ramp by the side door.
examples.zh: 餐厅侧门设有坡道，方便「接待」轮椅使用者。

words.enDefinition: causing or able to cause motion

examples.en: The police asked what motive the gardener had for removing the gate.
examples.zh: 警方询问园丁拆门的「动机」是什么。

examples.en: Love of the old building was her motive for buying the ruined mill.
examples.zh: 出于对老建筑的热爱，她买下了那座废磨坊，这正是她的「动机」。

words.enDefinition: worth having or seeking or achieving

examples.en: A south-facing kitchen is the most desirable feature of the little house.
examples.zh: 朝南的厨房是这栋小屋最「抢手的」亮点。

examples.en: It is desirable to book the ferry early in the holiday season.
examples.zh: 假期旺季最好「尽早」预订轮渡。

words.enDefinition: someone who has been admitted to membership in a scholarly field

examples.en: As the newest initiate, he fetches the chalk and rings the bell.
examples.zh: 作为最新的「新入会者」，他负责拿粉笔和摇铃。

examples.en: Each initiate swears to keep the society's recipes secret.
examples.zh: 每位「新会员」都要发誓保守社团的配方。

words.enDefinition: three-dimensional work of plastic art

examples.en: The park's bronze sculpture of two dancers attracts every wedding party.
examples.zh: 公园里那尊双人舞者的青铜「雕塑」是婚礼拍照必到之处。

examples.en: She studies sculpture and works mostly with driftwood and wire.
examples.zh: 她学「雕塑」，材料多用浮木和铁丝。

words.enDefinition: whole formed by a union of two or more elements or parts

examples.en: Common salt is a chemical compound of sodium and chlorine.
examples.zh: 食盐是一种由钠和氯组成的化学「化合物」。

examples.en: The medicine is a compound of four herbal extracts.
examples.zh: 这种药是四种草本成分合成的「复合制剂」。

words.enDefinition: the physical parts of a computer, and tools or equipment generally

examples.en: The shop sells garden hardware: trowels, hose fittings, and padlocks.
examples.zh: 这家店卖园艺「五金器具」：小铲、水管接头和挂锁。

examples.en: The laptop's hardware is fine; only the operating system needs updating.
examples.zh: 笔记本的「硬件」没问题，只是系统需要更新。

words.enDefinition: act in accordance with someone's rules, commands, or wishes

examples.en: The hostel failed to comply with the new fire regulations.
examples.zh: 这家旅舍没有「遵守」新的消防规定。

examples.en: All riders must comply with the helmet rule, coaches included.
examples.zh: 所有骑手都必须「遵守」戴头盔的规定，教练也不例外。

words.enDefinition: a loud, heavy blow or the noise made by shutting something hard

examples.en: The slam of the shed door startles the cat every time.
examples.zh: 每次棚门「砰的一声」，都会把猫吓一跳。

examples.en: Listen for the slam of the metal gate before the school bell.
examples.zh: 铁栅栏「砰然」一响，学校铃声随后就到。

words.enDefinition: society in an advanced state of social development (e.g., with complex legal and political and religious organizations)

examples.en: The museum traces how civilization reached these islands by sea.
examples.zh: 博物馆追溯了「文明」如何经海路传到这些岛屿。

examples.en: Ancient civilization flourished along the river for a thousand years.
examples.zh: 古代「文明」在这条河流域繁盛了一千年。

words.enDefinition: large and comfortable country house

examples.en: They rented a hillside villa with a lemon grove for August.
examples.zh: 八月他们租了山坡上一栋带柠檬园的「别墅」。

examples.en: The old villa by the gate has shutters painted sea-green.
examples.zh: 大门旁那座老「别墅」的百叶窗漆成了海绿色。

words.enDefinition: an undivided or unbroken completeness or totality with nothing wanting

examples.en: The judge's integrity was never questioned, even by losing parties.
examples.zh: 就连败诉方也从未质疑过法官的「正直」。

examples.en: Check the integrity of the hull before every long voyage.
examples.zh: 每次远航前都要检查船体的「完好性」。

words.enDefinition: an assembly (including one or more judges) to conduct judicial business

examples.en: The employment tribunal heard the cleaner's case on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 就业「仲裁庭」周二审理了这位清洁工的案子。

examples.en: A special tribunal will decide the boundary dispute between the farms.
examples.zh: 一个特别「法庭」将裁决两家农场间的地界纠纷。

words.enDefinition: an examination conducted by spoken communication

examples.en: She passed the oral part of the driving test first try.
examples.zh: 她一次就通过了驾照考试的「口试」部分。

examples.en: The oral exam lasts ten minutes, mostly about your chosen novel.
examples.zh: 「口试」十分钟，主要围绕你选的那本小说。

words.enDefinition: unpleasantly stern

examples.en: The coach's harsh criticism after the match surprised the young players.
examples.zh: 赛后教练「严厉的」批评让年轻队员很意外。

examples.en: Avoid harsh scouring pads on the new non-stick pan.
examples.zh: 新的不粘锅别用「粗糙的」钢丝球刷。

words.enDefinition: low continuous indistinct sound; often accompanied by movement of the lips without the production of articulate speech

examples.en: Grandfather mutters to his roses while he prunes them.
examples.zh: 爷爷修剪玫瑰时会对着花丛「喃喃自语」。

examples.en: She muttered an apology and wiped the spilt tea from the keyboard.
examples.zh: 她「低声」道歉着，擦掉洒在键盘上的茶水。

words.enDefinition: free from ambiguity

examples.en: The assembly instructions are straightforward: two pages and eight screws.
examples.zh: 组装说明「简单明了」：两页纸、八颗螺丝。

examples.en: She gave a straightforward answer about why the club lost money.
examples.zh: 对于俱乐部亏损的原因，她给出了「坦率的」回答。

words.enDefinition: woman whose husband is dead especially one who has not remarried

examples.en: The war widow still lays flowers at the memorial every November.
examples.zh: 每年十一月，那位「遗孀」仍会到纪念碑前献花。

examples.en: As a young widow, she ran the bakery alone for twenty years.
examples.zh: 年纪轻轻守寡后，她独自经营面包房二十年。

words.enDefinition: the quality of being humane

examples.en: The volunteers' quiet kindness restored our faith in humanity.
examples.zh: 志愿者默默的善举让我们重拾对「人性」的信心。

examples.en: Great novels remind us what we share in our humanity.
examples.zh: 伟大的小说提醒我们，「人性」中有哪些相通之处。

words.enDefinition: causing or capable of causing death

examples.en: The cliff path has no railings and a deadly drop below.
examples.zh: 崖边小路没有护栏，脚下就是「致命的」深渊。

examples.en: Some wild mushrooms are deadly when eaten raw or undercooked.
examples.zh: 有些野生蘑菇生吃或未煮熟是「致命的」。

words.enDefinition: small wild or domesticated web-footed broad-billed swimming bird usually having a depressed body and short legs

examples.en: The ducks queue hopefully by the pond railings at feeding time.
examples.zh: 喂食时间一到，「鸭子」们就在池塘栏杆边排起队。

examples.en: Roast duck with plum sauce is our festival treat.
examples.zh: 「烤鸭」配酸梅酱是我们过节的美味。

words.enDefinition: appeal or request earnestly

examples.en: She pleaded with the landlord to fix the boiler before winter.
examples.zh: 她「恳求」房东在入冬前修好锅炉。

examples.en: The defendant pleaded not guilty through his court lawyer.
examples.zh: 被告通过律师「答辩」称无罪。

words.enDefinition: two (or more) slices of bread with a filling between them

examples.en: Dad makes a cheese sandwich exactly the same way every morning.
examples.zh: 爸爸每天早上都一模一样地做奶酪「三明治」。

examples.en: Share the sandwich between the two of you; it's huge.
examples.zh: 这个「三明治」太大了，你们俩分着吃吧。

words.enDefinition: a place where ships are loaded and unloaded or repaired

examples.en: The fishing boats unload at the dock before the market opens.
examples.zh: 开市前，渔船在「码头」卸货。

examples.en: The old ship sits in dry dock for its yearly paint.
examples.zh: 那艘老船进「船坞」干修，准备年度刷漆。

words.enDefinition: residential district located on the outskirts of a city

examples.en: They moved to a quiet suburb where the schools are walking distance.
examples.zh: 他们搬到了一个安静的「郊区」，学校步行即到。

examples.en: The train links the northern suburbs with the city centre every ten minutes.
examples.zh: 北部「市郊」的火车每十分钟一班直达市中心。

words.enDefinition: characterized by grandeur

examples.en: The view from the bell tower is absolutely magnificent in autumn.
examples.zh: 秋天从钟楼上望去，景色「壮丽无比」。

examples.en: She wore her grandmother's magnificent emerald brooch at the wedding.
examples.zh: 婚礼上，她戴着祖母那枚「华美的」祖母绿胸针。

words.enDefinition: the main stem of a tree; usually covered with bark; the bole is usually the part that is commercially useful for lumber

examples.en: Squirrels chase each other up and down the old oak trunk.
examples.zh: 松鼠们围着老橡树「树干」上蹿下跳。

examples.en: The fallen trunk across the stream makes a natural bridge.
examples.zh: 横在小溪上的倒下「树干」成了一座天然便桥。

words.enDefinition: piece of poetry

examples.en: She learned the second verse of the folk song by heart.
examples.zh: 她把那首民歌的第二「节」背了下来。

examples.en: The wedding card included a handwritten verse from the groom's grandmother.
examples.zh: 婚礼贺卡里附有新郎祖母手写的一「节诗」。

words.enDefinition: an evil supernatural being

examples.en: According to the play, the devil tempts the farmer with a golden scythe.
examples.zh: 剧里说，「魔鬼」用一把金镰刀引诱农夫。

examples.en: Kids dare each other to touch the devil statue in the old church.
examples.zh: 孩子们互相打赌，谁敢摸老教堂里的「魔鬼」雕像。

words.enDefinition: the act of taking something from someone unlawfully

examples.en: Report the theft of the bicycle to the police within a day.
examples.zh: 自行车被「盗」后，请在一天内报警。

examples.en: Insurance covers theft from the van if the windows are shut.
examples.zh: 只要车窗关好，货车内的失「窃」保险能赔。

words.enDefinition: steep high face of rock

examples.en: The lighthouse stands on the cliff where the seabirds nest.
examples.zh: 灯塔矗立在「悬崖」上，海鸟就在那筑巢。

examples.en: They watched the sunset from the cliff path with thermoses of tea.
examples.zh: 他们提着保温瓶茶水，在「峭壁」小路上看日落。

words.enDefinition: maintain or assert

examples.en: Historians contend that the bridge is older than the abbey.
examples.zh: 历史学家「主张」这座桥比修道院还古老。

examples.en: She had to contend with a leaking roof all winter.
examples.zh: 整个冬天她都得「应付」漏雨的屋顶。

words.enDefinition: an orderly arrangement

examples.en: The spice stall displays an impressive array of colours and smells.
examples.zh: 香料摊上「陈列着」色彩与气味都令人惊叹的「一排排」货品。

examples.en: The baker's window shows an array of iced buns every Friday.
examples.zh: 每逢周五，面包店橱窗「摆满」一「排排」糖霜小圆包。

words.enDefinition: create by putting components or members together

examples.en: The scouts assemble by the flagpole at ten sharp every Saturday.
examples.zh: 每周六十点整，童子军在旗杆旁「集合」。

examples.en: Grandfather can assemble the flat-pack shed in an afternoon.
examples.zh: 爷爷一个下午就能「组装」好那套板式棚屋。

words.enDefinition: the quality of being loyal

examples.en: The postman's loyalty to his round never wavered in forty years.
examples.zh: 四十年间，老邮差对这条投递路线的「忠诚」从未动摇。

examples.en: The dog's loyalty was rewarded with a place by the fire.
examples.zh: 狗狗的「忠心」换来了一块炉边专属地盘。

words.enDefinition: position 18 in a countable series of things

examples.en: The bakery opens its eighteenth branch by the station next month.
examples.zh: 下个月，这家面包房将在车站旁开出「第十八家」分店。

examples.en: She finished eighteenth in the county cross-country run.
examples.zh: 她在郡越野赛中获得「第十八名」。

words.enDefinition: By which; -- used relatively.

examples.en: They set up a trust whereby the orchard pays for the school books.
examples.zh: 他们设立了一项信托，「凭此」果园收益可为学校买书。

examples.en: A toll was introduced whereby lorry drivers pay for road repairs.
examples.zh: 新开征的通行费「据此」让卡车司机分担道路维修费用。

words.enDefinition: something immaterial that stands in the way and must be circumvented or surmounted

examples.en: The fallen elm was the last obstacle on the flooded lane.
examples.zh: 倒下的榆树是积水小巷的最后一处「障碍」。

examples.en: Shyness was the biggest obstacle to her singing in public.
examples.zh: 「羞怯」是她当众唱歌的最大「障碍」。

words.enDefinition: person who follows next in order

examples.en: The retiring head teacher introduces her successor at the autumn assembly.
examples.zh: 秋季开学典礼上，即将退休的校长介绍了自己的「继任者」。

examples.en: The old clockmaker trained his successor for three years before retiring.
examples.zh: 老钟表匠退休前花了三年培养「接班人」。

words.enDefinition: signal for attracting attention

examples.en: The fuel indicator flickers above half on the steep hill.
examples.zh: 陡坡上，油表「指示器」在半格上方闪动。

examples.en: Early leaf fall is a reliable indicator of a hard winter.
examples.zh: 落叶早，往往「预示着」寒冬将至。

words.enDefinition: device that removes something from whatever passes through it

examples.en: Replace the paper coffee filter before the morning rush begins.
examples.zh: 早高峰来临前，先把咖啡「滤纸」换掉。

examples.en: The pond filter keeps the water clear enough to see the goldfish.
examples.zh: 池塘「过滤器」让水清得能看清金鱼。

words.enDefinition: one who supervises or has charge and direction of

examples.en: The night supervisor checks the ovens one last time before locking up.
examples.zh: 打烊前，夜班「主管」会最后检查一遍烤炉。

examples.en: Ask the floor supervisor before moving the ladder, for safety.
examples.zh: 为安全起见，挪梯子前先问一下当班「主管」。

words.enDefinition: series of ordered groupings of people or things within a system

examples.en: In the kitchen, the hierarchy is clear: head chef, sous chefs, apprentices.
examples.zh: 后厨「等级分明」：主厨、副厨、学徒。

examples.en: The emails climbed the company hierarchy before reaching a decision.
examples.zh: 邮件在公司「层级」里层层上报，才等到决定。

words.enDefinition: identifying the nature or cause of some phenomenon

examples.en: The vet's diagnosis was a mild allergy to the new soap.
examples.zh: 兽医「诊断」是对新肥皂轻度过敏。

examples.en: A second doctor confirmed the diagnosis of the old fracture.
examples.zh: 第二位医生证实了那处旧骨折的「诊断」。

words.enDefinition: the head of the Roman Catholic Church

examples.en: The portrait of the young pope hangs beside the cathedral door.
examples.zh: 年轻「教皇」的画像就挂在主教座堂门口旁。

examples.en: History class covers how the medieval pope settled that dispute.
examples.zh: 历史课讲到中世纪「教皇」如何化解了那场争端。

words.enDefinition: all living things (except people) that are undomesticated

examples.en: The hedgerow provides food and shelter for the local wildlife.
examples.zh: 灌木树篱为当地「野生动植物」提供食物和栖息处。

examples.en: Night cameras captured wildlife drinking at the restored pond.
examples.zh: 夜间相机拍到了「野生动物」在修复后的池塘边饮水。

words.enDefinition: someone engaged in or experienced in warfare

examples.en: The museum armour once belonged to a twelfth-century warrior.
examples.zh: 博物馆里那套盔甲曾属于一位十二世纪的「武士」。

examples.en: Grandmother fought her long illness like a true warrior.
examples.zh: 奶奶像真正的「战士」一样与病魔抗争到底。

words.enDefinition: person to whom money is owed by a debtor; someone to whom an obligation exists

examples.en: The small printer repaid each creditor before the business closed.
examples.zh: 关店之前，那家小印刷厂还清了每位「债主」的钱。

examples.en: As a creditor, the bank questioned the expansion plan.
examples.zh: 作为「债权人」，银行对扩建计划提出了质疑。

words.enDefinition: lacking any definite plan or order or purpose; governed by or depending on chance

examples.en: The raffle draws names at random from the membership box.
examples.zh: 抽奖从会员箱中「随机」抽取名单。

examples.en: A random patch of blue appeared between the grey clouds.
examples.zh: 灰云之间「随意地」露出一小块蓝天。

words.enDefinition: the state of having committed an offense

examples.en: He carried the guilt of the broken window for a week.
examples.zh: 打碎玻璃的「内疚」让他在心里憋了一个星期。

examples.en: The court found no guilt in the shepherd's actions.
examples.zh: 法庭认定牧羊人的行为并无「罪责」。

words.enDefinition: strikingly odd, strange, or unusual

examples.en: Weird lights crossed the sky that night, probably a satellite.
examples.zh: 那晚「怪异」的光划过夜空，多半是颗卫星。

examples.en: The freezer makes a weird humming noise before it clicks off.
examples.zh: 冰箱停机前会发出「奇怪的」嗡嗡声。

words.enDefinition: a wide street in a town; also a way of achieving something

examples.en: Linden trees shade the long avenue all through summer.
examples.zh: 整条「大街」的菩提树在夏天撑起浓荫。

examples.en: Volunteering proved a good avenue into the museum world.
examples.zh: 志愿服务被证明是进入博物馆行业的绝佳「途径」。

words.enDefinition: any admirable quality or attribute

examples.en: The plan has merit, though the parking problem remains.
examples.zh: 这个方案有「可取之处」，只是停车问题依然存在。

examples.en: She earned her merit badge by mapping the whole nature trail.
examples.zh: 她把整条自然小径测绘了一遍，赢得了「奖章」。

words.enDefinition: one of the jointed appendages of an animal used for locomotion or grasping: arm; leg; wing; flipper

examples.en: The cat stretched every limb before jumping off the windowsill.
examples.zh: 猫跳下窗台前把每条「四肢」都伸展开来。

examples.en: Climbers check each limb of the old apple tree before picking.
examples.zh: 采摘前，大家会检查老苹果树的每根「大枝」。

words.enDefinition: offensive or even (of persons) malicious

examples.en: A nasty cut on the thumb needs more than a plaster.
examples.zh: 大拇指上这道「严重的」口子，光贴创可贴可不够。

examples.en: The campers left a nasty mess by the spring.
examples.zh: 野营的人在泉边留下一摊「恶心的」垃圾。

words.enDefinition: put up with something or somebody unpleasant

examples.en: These boots will endure at least five winters of rain.
examples.zh: 这双靴子至少能「经受」五个雨季。

examples.en: The old lighthouse keeper endured loneliness better than any storm.
examples.zh: 与任何风暴相比，老守塔人更能「忍受」孤独。

words.enDefinition: being long-lasting and recurrent or characterized by long suffering

examples.en: His chronic back pain improves with the standing desk.
examples.zh: 站立式办公桌让他的「慢性」背痛有所好转。

examples.en: The bakery suffers chronic shortages of good flour every winter.
examples.zh: 每年冬天，面包店都「长期」缺好面粉。

words.enDefinition: work in an administrative capacity; supervise or be in charge of

examples.en: The nurse administers the insulin dose after each meal.
examples.zh: 每餐之后，护士「施用」胰岛素。

examples.en: The charity administers the winter fuel fund for the village.
examples.zh: 慈善机构负责「管理」村里的冬季燃料基金。

words.enDefinition: the act of sending a message; causing a message to be transmitted

examples.en: The radio transmission faded as the van drove into the hills.
examples.zh: 面包车驶入山区，无线电「信号传输」渐渐减弱。

examples.en: Hand washing remains the simplest guard against transmission of the virus.
examples.zh: 洗手仍是最简单的防止病毒「传播」的办法。

words.enDefinition: liquid that is spilled

examples.en: Clean the oil spill on the drive before someone slips.
examples.zh: 趁没人滑倒，快把车道上的「油污」清理掉。

examples.en: The coffee spill stained the minutes, not the keyboard.
examples.zh: 咖啡「洒」出来弄脏了会议记录，键盘倒是没事。

words.enDefinition: cutting or thrusting weapon that has a long metal blade and a hilt with a hand guard

examples.en: The ceremonial sword leads the town parade every midsummer.
examples.zh: 每年仲夏游行都由仪仗「剑」开路。

examples.en: Fencing class teaches you to hold the sword lightly, not tightly.
examples.zh: 击剑课教你要「持剑」轻灵，不能死攥。

words.enDefinition: made to appear real by computer simulation; also almost actual

examples.en: The museum offers a virtual tour of the closed wing.
examples.zh: 博物馆为关闭的展厅提供「虚拟」游览。

examples.en: The two systems are in virtual agreement on the numbers.
examples.zh: 两套系统在数字上「几乎完全」一致。

words.enDefinition: substance that is fluid at room temperature and pressure

examples.en: Top up the brake fluid before the long drive to the coast.
examples.zh: 长途去海边之前，先补足刹车「液体」。

examples.en: Water is the most familiar fluid in every kitchen.
examples.zh: 水是每个厨房里最常见「流体」。

words.enDefinition: freedom to act or judge on one's own

examples.en: Leave the gate unlocked at your own discretion.
examples.zh: 是否留门不上锁，请「自行斟酌」。

examples.en: The concierge showed great discretion about the guests' names.
examples.zh: 门房对客人姓名「守口如瓶」，十分「慎重」。

words.enDefinition: an alphabetical list of names and addresses

examples.en: The building directory lists every clinic by floor and room.
examples.zh: 大楼「楼层索引」按楼层和房间列出每家诊所。

examples.en: Look up the plumber's number in the business directory.
examples.zh: 水管工的电话在工商「名录」里查得到。

words.enDefinition: socially or conventionally correct; refined or virtuous

examples.en: A decent raincoat matters more than a fancy umbrella here.
examples.zh: 在这里，一件「像样的」雨衣比花哨的雨伞管用。

examples.en: It wasn't decent to gossip about the new tenants so soon.
examples.zh: 这么快就议论新住户，实在「不厚道」。

words.enDefinition: group of people or things arranged or following in order

examples.en: A succession of wet weekends ruined the tennis season.
examples.zh: 接连「一连串」的雨天周末毁了整个网球赛季。

examples.en: The estate has passed in unbroken succession to eldest sons.
examples.zh: 这份产业「一代代」由长子无缝「继承」。

words.enDefinition: something (such as a fact or circumstance) that shows an action to be reasonable or necessary

examples.en: The receipt is your justification for the travel refund.
examples.zh: 这张收据是你报销差旅费的「依据」。

examples.en: There is no justification for raising the market fees twice.
examples.zh: 把集市费涨两次，毫无「正当理由」。

words.enDefinition: using language effectively to please or persuade

examples.en: Ignore the rhetoric and read what the plan actually changes.
examples.zh: 别管那些「漂亮话」，看看方案究竟改了什么。

examples.en: His courtroom rhetoric won the case more than the evidence did.
examples.zh: 他的法庭「雄辩」比证据更能打动陪审团。

words.enDefinition: a wild, natural area where few people live

examples.en: The northern wilderness hides wolves, lynx, and old gold mines.
examples.zh: 北部的「荒野」藏着狼、猞猁和旧金矿。

examples.en: After two days of walking, the wilderness felt like home.
examples.zh: 走了两天之后，这片「荒野」竟有了家的感觉。

words.enDefinition: precisely and clearly expressed or readily observable; leaving nothing to implication

examples.en: The recipe is explicit about resting the dough twice.
examples.zh: 食谱「明确」要求面团醒发两次。

examples.en: She was explicit that the ladder rule applies to everyone.
examples.zh: 她「直截了当地」说明，爬梯规定人人适用。

words.enDefinition: the entrance (the space in a wall) through which you enter or leave a room or building; the space that a door can close

examples.en: The cat watches the whole street from the safe doorway.
examples.zh: 猫在「门口」安全地注视着整条街。

examples.en: Paint drips marked the doorway where the new frame went in.
examples.zh: 油漆滴痕标出了新门框装上的那处「门洞」。

words.enDefinition: existing as an idea rather than as a physical object; not concrete

examples.en: Freedom is an abstract idea until you lose it.
examples.zh: 「自由」在失去之前只是一个「抽象」概念。

examples.en: The painting is too abstract for the parish hall, they said.
examples.zh: 他们说，这幅画太「抽象」，不适合教区礼堂。

words.enDefinition: showing intellectual penetration or emotional depth

examples.en: The old bell has a profound voice that carries across the bay.
examples.zh: 老钟声「深沉浑厚」，响彻整个海湾。

examples.en: Losing the farm taught her a profound lesson about insurance.
examples.zh: 失去农场给她上了关于保险的「深刻」一课。

words.enDefinition: long thick piece of wood or metal or concrete, etc., used in construction

examples.en: The oak beam across the kitchen carries the old chimney.
examples.zh: 厨房上方的橡木「横梁」支撑着老烟囱。

examples.en: A beam of morning light fell across the flour sacks.
examples.zh: 一「道」晨光落在面粉袋上。

words.enDefinition: able to be compared or worthy of comparison

examples.en: The rent is comparable to the flat two streets away.
examples.zh: 这处租金与两条街外那套公寓「相当」。

examples.en: Their two harvests are comparable in size this year.
examples.zh: 今年两家的收成「不相上下」。

words.enDefinition: physicist who studies astronomy

examples.en: The retired astronomer sets his telescope on the pier every clear night.
examples.zh: 每个晴夜，退休「天文学家」都会把望远镜架在码头上。

examples.en: The young astronomer explained the comet's path in plain words.
examples.zh: 年轻的「天文学家」用大白话讲解彗星轨迹。

words.enDefinition: provoking horror

examples.en: The horrible smell from the drain finally made us call the plumber.
examples.zh: 下水道「难闻的」臭味终于让我们下决心叫水管工。

examples.en: A horrible squeak starts whenever the old gate swings open.
examples.zh: 老门一开就发出「刺耳难听」的吱嘎声。

words.enDefinition: haphazard distribution in all directions

examples.en: The wind caught the flyers and sent them scattering down the street.
examples.zh: 风卷起传单，把它们吹得沿街「四散」。

examples.en: With one clap, the farmer scattered the sparrows from the seed sacks.
examples.zh: 农夫一击掌，麻雀便从种子袋上「哄然散开」。

words.enDefinition: public meeting or assembly for open discussion

examples.en: The village hall hosts a monthly forum on local planning.
examples.zh: 村政厅每月举办一次地方规划「论坛」。

examples.en: Parents raised the traffic issue at the school forum.
examples.zh: 家长们在学校「讨论会」上提出了交通问题。

words.enDefinition: facial expression of dislike or displeasure

examples.en: A frown crossed her face as she read the bill again.
examples.zh: 重新读账单时，她脸上「皱起了眉头」。

examples.en: The teacher's frown said more than any spoken warning.
examples.zh: 老师「皱眉」的表情，比任何口头警告都管用。

words.enDefinition: provide physical relief, as from pain

examples.en: A warm compress will relieve the ache in your shoulder.
examples.zh: 热敷能「缓解」你肩膀的酸痛。

examples.en: The spare key relieved my worry about locking myself out.
examples.zh: 备用钥匙「解除了」我对自己被锁门外的担忧。

words.enDefinition: having a meaning or purpose

examples.en: The pensioners found meaningful work mentoring the apprentices.
examples.zh: 老人们觉得带学徒这份工作很有「意义」。

examples.en: A meaningful apology includes what you will do differently.
examples.zh: 有「诚意」的道歉要说明你今后会如何改进。

words.enDefinition: person's partner in marriage

examples.en: Employees may add their spouse to the dental plan.
examples.zh: 员工可以把「配偶」加入牙科保险计划。

examples.en: Each spouse keeps their own bank book in this household.
examples.zh: 在这个家里，夫妻「双方」各管各自的存折。

words.enDefinition: marked by blithe unconcern

examples.en: Keep the interview casual, but arrive on time.
examples.zh: 面试保持「随意轻松」，但一定要准时到。

examples.en: A casual remark over the fence led to the job offer.
examples.zh: 篱笆边一句「漫不经心的」闲聊，竟带来了这份工作。

words.enDefinition: obtain from someone after their death

examples.en: She will inherit the orchard when her aunt retires to the coast.
examples.zh: 姑妈退居海边后，她将「继承」那片果园。

examples.en: The new captain inherited a young but eager crew.
examples.zh: 新船长「接手」了一支年轻而热忱的船员队伍。

words.enDefinition: a short passage taken from a book or film; a substance obtained from something

examples.en: The teacher read a short extract from the sea novel aloud.
examples.zh: 老师大声朗读了那本海洋小说的一个「选段」。

examples.en: Vanilla extract gives the custard its gentle smell.
examples.zh: 「香草提取液」给蛋奶冻带来淡淡的香气。

words.enDefinition: the quality of a substance that is able to rebound

examples.en: The old tennis balls lose their bounce after one summer.
examples.zh: 旧网球过一个夏天就没了「弹性」。

examples.en: Give the baby a gentle bounce on your knee.
examples.zh: 把宝宝放在膝上轻轻「颠一颠」。

words.enDefinition: state of high honor

examples.en: The choir sang about glory at the spring concert.
examples.zh: 春季音乐会上，合唱团唱起了赞美「荣耀」的歌。

examples.en: Winning the cup was the glory of his quiet career.
examples.zh: 捧起奖杯是他平淡职业生涯的「高光时刻」。

words.enDefinition: to give time, effort, or a building to a particular purpose

examples.en: Grandfather dedicated his weekends to restoring the rowing boat.
examples.zh: 爷爷把周末都「献给」了那条赛艇的修复。

examples.en: The mayor dedicated the new library wing on Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 周六上午，市长为图书馆新翼「落成启用」剪彩。

words.enDefinition: form by carving

examples.en: Grandfather carves little sailing boats from pine offcuts for the fair.
examples.zh: 爷爷用松木边角料「雕」出小帆船，拿到集市卖。

examples.en: Carve the turkey at the table so everyone sees the slices.
examples.zh: 火鸡就在餐桌上「切」，让大家都能看到切好的肉片。

words.enDefinition: being or affecting only a part; not total

examples.en: The old bridge reopened with only partial repairs before the fair.
examples.zh: 集市前，老桥只做了「部分」修缮就重新开放。

examples.en: The refund was partial because the ticket was discounted.
examples.zh: 由于票是折扣票，退款只有「一部分」。

words.enDefinition: protruding abdomen

examples.en: The robin puffs its red belly against the winter cold.
examples.zh: 知更鸟鼓起红色「腹部」的羽毛抵御寒冬。

examples.en: He rubbed his full belly after the harvest supper.
examples.zh: 丰收晚宴后，他「摸着」吃得饱饱的「肚子」。

words.enDefinition: to form an idea or plan in the mind

examples.en: The twins could not conceive of a kitchen without the big stove.
examples.zh: 这对双胞胎无法「想象」没有大炉灶的厨房。

examples.en: The bridge was conceived by a stonemason, not an engineer.
examples.zh: 这座桥的「构想」出自石匠而非工程师。

words.enDefinition: supply food ready to eat; for parties and banquets

examples.en: The family bakery will cater the christening lunch.
examples.zh: 家族面包房将为洗礼午宴「承办餐食」。

examples.en: The village hostel caters for vegetarians if you ask ahead.
examples.zh: 只要提前说一声，村里的旅舍可以为素食者「备餐」。

words.enDefinition: public transport that consists of a bus or train or airplane that plies back and forth between two points

examples.en: The free shuttle runs between the station and the harbour every quarter hour.
examples.zh: 免费「摆渡车」每十五分钟往返车站和港口。

examples.en: We caught the airport shuttle without printing any ticket.
examples.zh: 我们没打印任何票据就搭上了机场「班车」。

words.enDefinition: extraordinarily good or great; used especially as intensifiers

examples.en: The marvellous lemon tart won first prize at the fete.
examples.zh: 那款「绝妙的」柠檬挞在游园会上拿了一等奖。

examples.en: You've done a marvellous job restoring the garden gate.
examples.zh: 你把花园门修得「太棒了」。

words.enDefinition: the middle of the day

examples.en: The market stalls close at noon on Wednesdays for the ferry.
examples.zh: 周三的集市摊位「正午」收摊，好赶上轮渡。

examples.en: We meet at noon by the clock tower, rain or shine.
examples.zh: 无论晴雨，我们「中午」十二点在钟楼下碰头。

words.enDefinition: small replica of a person; used as a toy

examples.en: The old doll with the chipped cheek sits on the high shelf.
examples.zh: 那个脸颊缺了块漆的老「洋娃娃」摆在高架上。

examples.en: Grandmother sewed a new dress for the doll from leftover calico.
examples.zh: 奶奶用剩下的印花布给「娃娃」缝了条新裙子。

words.enDefinition: characterized by a high degree or intensity; often used as a combining form

examples.en: Grandfather moved from the intensive care unit to a normal ward.
examples.zh: 爷爷从「重症监护」病房转到了普通病房。

examples.en: She took an intensive French course before the exchange year.
examples.zh: 交换年前，她上了一个「强化」法语班。

words.enDefinition: determine or distinguish the nature of a problem or an illness through a diagnostic analysis

examples.en: The pharmacist diagnosed mild sunburn and recommended aloe.
examples.zh: 药剂师「诊断」为轻度晒伤，推荐了芦荟胶。

examples.en: The garage diagnosed the rattle as a loose heat shield.
examples.zh: 修车厂「查明」异响是隔热罩松动。

words.enDefinition: form a mental image of something that is not present or that is not the case

examples.en: I never envisaged the village without its annual fair.
examples.zh: 我从未「设想」过没有年度游园会的村子会是什么样。

examples.en: The plan envisages a footbridge by the old lock.
examples.zh: 该方案「设想」在旧船闸旁建一座步行桥。

words.enDefinition: sign posted in a public place as an advertisement

examples.en: The concert poster on the bakery window faded in one summer.
examples.zh: 贴在面包房橱窗上的音乐会「海报」一个夏天就褪色了。

examples.en: She designs the poster for the school play every year.
examples.zh: 每年学校话剧的「海报」都由她设计。

words.enDefinition: very slow movement

examples.en: Traffic slowed to a crawl behind the tractor on market day.
examples.zh: 赶集日，车流跟在拖拉机后面「缓慢挪动」。

examples.en: The baby's first crawl went straight for the cat bowl.
examples.zh: 宝宝第一次「爬行」就直奔猫碗而去。

words.enDefinition: pleasing in appearance especially by reason of conformity to ideals of form and proportion

examples.en: The handsome stone bridge appears on every postcard of the town.
examples.zh: 那座「气派的」石桥印在了小镇每张明信片上。

examples.en: A handsome reward was offered for the lost sheepdog.
examples.zh: 寻回那只走失牧羊犬可获得「丰厚的」酬金。

words.enDefinition: a person who gives individual teaching, often privately

examples.en: My maths tutor comes every Tuesday after the rowing practice.
examples.zh: 我的数学「家教」每周二划船训练后过来。

examples.en: The university tutor reviews each essay with the student in person.
examples.zh: 大学「导师」会与学生当面逐篇点评文章。

words.enDefinition: inborn pattern of behavior often responsive to specific stimuli

examples.en: By instinct, the cat heads for the warmest corner at dusk.
examples.zh: 出于「本能」，猫在黄昏时分总奔向最暖的角落。

examples.en: His first instinct was to check the children before the phones.
examples.zh: 他的第一「本能反应」是先看孩子，再看手机。

words.enDefinition: any of various large keen-sighted diurnal birds of prey noted for their broad wings and strong soaring flight

examples.en: A white-tailed eagle circled above the salmon river at noon.
examples.zh: 一只白尾「鹰」在鲑鱼河上空盘旋。

examples.en: The eagle on the regiment's banner has a missing thread.
examples.zh: 团旗上的「鹰」徽少了一根线。

words.enDefinition: minor match preceding the main event

examples.en: The preliminary heats start at eight, well before the finals.
examples.zh: 「预赛」八点开始，比决赛早得多。

examples.en: The engineer took preliminary measurements before quoting the extension.
examples.zh: 报价扩建工程之前，工程师先做了「初步」测量。

words.enDefinition: a paved path at the side of a street for people to walk on

examples.en: Ice on the pavement makes the school run slow in January.
examples.zh: 一月里，「人行道」结冰，上学路都变慢了。

examples.en: Cyclists should dismount where the pavement narrows by the bridge.
examples.zh: 桥边「人行道」变窄处，骑车人应下车推行。

words.enDefinition: particular environment or walk of life

examples.en: Waste collection falls outside the council's sphere of duty.
examples.zh: 垃圾清运不在市政「职责范围」之内。

examples.en: She moved from the teaching sphere into museum work.
examples.zh: 她从「教育领域」转行进了博物馆。

words.enDefinition: to rule as a monarch; to be dominant

examples.en: Queen Eleanor reigned for forty years of steady harvests.
examples.zh: 埃莉诺女王「在位」四十年，年年风调雨顺。

examples.en: Silence reigned in the hall while the results were read.
examples.zh: 宣读结果时，大厅里一片「寂静」。

words.enDefinition: having or exercising influence or power

examples.en: The influential gardener persuaded the council to keep the meadow.
examples.zh: 那位「有影响力的」园丁说服市政保留了草地。

examples.en: Her influential articles changed how the town recycles glass.
examples.zh: 她「颇具影响力的」文章改变了小镇回收玻璃的方式。

words.enDefinition: the act of pursuing in an effort to overtake or capture

examples.en: The fox led the hounds a long pursuit across two counties.
examples.zh: 狐狸带着猎犬长途「追捕」，跨越了两个郡。

examples.en: The pursuit of good bread takes patience more than talent.
examples.zh: 「追求」好面包，耐心比天赋更重要。

words.enDefinition: that which is perceived or known or inferred to have its own distinct existence (living or nonliving)

examples.en: The two charities merged into a single legal entity.
examples.zh: 两家慈善机构合并为一个独立「实体」。

examples.en: Keep the shop's accounts separate from the family's as a business entity.
examples.zh: 店铺作为一个经营「实体」，账目须与家庭开销分开。

words.enDefinition: charge against a citizen's person or property or activity for the support of government

examples.en: Market traders pay a small tax for the pitch each Saturday.
examples.zh: 集市摊主每周六为摊位缴纳少量「税金」。

examples.en: The bridge toll replaced the old road tax decades ago.
examples.zh: 桥梁通行费几十年前就取代了旧的路「税」。

words.enDefinition: term of address for a man

examples.en: Excuse me, sir, your ticket is for tomorrow's boat.
examples.zh: 打扰一下，「先生」，您的票是明天那班船的。

examples.en: The letter began 'Dear Sir' and ended with the school's seal.
examples.zh: 信以「尊敬的先生」开头，盖着学校的印章收尾。

words.enDefinition: a blow, or a thing that becomes very popular

examples.en: The new song was an instant hit at the summer fair.
examples.zh: 新歌在夏季游园会上一炮而「红」，大受欢迎。

examples.en: He took a hit on the helmet but stayed on the field.
examples.zh: 他头盔挨了一「击」，但仍留在了场上。

words.enDefinition: slippery or viscous liquid or liquefiable substance not miscible with water

examples.en: Add a spoon of oil to the pasta water so it never sticks.
examples.zh: 在煮面水里加一勺「油」，面条就永不粘连。

examples.en: The sewing machine runs smoothly after its drop of oil.
examples.zh: 滴过「油」之后，缝纫机运转顺滑多了。

words.enDefinition: red color or pigment; the chromatic color resembling the hue of blood

examples.en: The postbox's red paint needs touching up after the winter.
examples.zh: 过完冬天，邮筒的「红色」漆面该补一补了。

examples.en: She chose the red apples over the green ones for the pie.
examples.zh: 做派她挑了「红」苹果，没选青苹果。

words.enDefinition: the upper part of anything

examples.en: The honey jar sits on the top shelf behind the flour.
examples.zh: 蜂蜜罐放在面粉后面最上层的架子「顶端」。

examples.en: Reach the top of the stairs and turn left for the bathroom.
examples.zh: 上到楼梯「顶端」后左转就是浴室。

words.enDefinition: small open container usually used for drinking; usually has a handle

examples.en: Grandmother's wedding cup is used only for christening toasts.
examples.zh: 奶奶的婚礼「杯」只在洗礼祝酒时使用。

examples.en: A cup of cocoa warms the night-shift dog walker.
examples.zh: 一「杯」热可可温暖了深夜遛狗人。

words.enDefinition: two-winged insects characterized by active flight

examples.en: One fly followed us all round the orchard ladders.
examples.zh: 一只「苍蝇」跟着我们绕遍了果园的梯子。

examples.en: The fly on the window screen waits for autumn.
examples.zh: 纱窗上的那只「苍蝇」在等秋天。

words.enDefinition: take in solid food

examples.en: Eat your greens before the pudding; that is the house rule.
examples.zh: 先「吃」青菜再吃布丁，这是家里的规矩。

examples.en: What did you eat at the harbour cafe today?
examples.zh: 今天你在港口咖啡馆「吃」了什么？

words.enDefinition: piece of furniture that provides a place to sleep

examples.en: Make the bed before breakfast, as Grandmother insisted.
examples.zh: 按奶奶的规矩，早餐前先「铺床」。

examples.en: The spare bed by the window hosts every holiday guest.
examples.zh: 窗边的备用「床」接待了每一位假日来客。

words.enDefinition: division of an ocean or a large body of salt water partially enclosed by land

examples.en: The sea calmed enough by evening for the rowing club.
examples.zh: 傍晚「海面」平静下来，划船俱乐部照常训练。

examples.en: Sea air cures everything, according to grandfather's old saying.
examples.zh: 照爷爷的老话，「海边」的空气包治百病。

words.enDefinition: used of physical heat; having a high or higher than desirable temperature or giving off heat or feeling or causing a sensation of heat or burning

examples.en: The hot bread tray empties within minutes at the bakery.
examples.zh: 面包房的「热」面包托盘几分钟就被拿空。

examples.en: Careful, the kettle is still hot from the second pot.
examples.zh: 小心，水壶刚烧第二壶，「还很烫」。

words.enDefinition: broadcasting visual images of stationary or moving objects

examples.en: The living room TV stays off during family dinners.
examples.zh: 全家晚餐时间，客厅「电视」是关着的。

examples.en: They watched the match replay on the cafe TV after the shift.
examples.zh: 下班后，他们在咖啡馆的「电视」上看了比赛回放。

words.enDefinition: member of the genus Canis (probably descended from the common wolf) that has been domesticated by man since prehistoric times; occurs in many breeds

examples.en: The neighbour's dog waits at the school fence every afternoon.
examples.zh: 邻居家的「狗」每天下午都在学校栅栏旁等候。

examples.en: A dog saved the flock by barking before the storm hit.
examples.zh: 风暴来袭前，那条「狗」的吠叫救了羊群。

words.enDefinition: (usually rectangular) container; may have a lid

examples.en: The parcel box by the gate holds deliveries when we are out.
examples.zh: 我们外出时，门口的包裹「箱」会代收快递。

examples.en: Label each moving box with the room, not the contents.
examples.zh: 搬家的每个「纸箱」都标注房间，而不是物品。

words.enDefinition: negative connective or particle, introducing the second

examples.en: He neither called nor wrote after their argument last spring.
examples.zh: 去年春天争吵之后，他既没「打电话也」没写信。

examples.en: The toolshed has no window nor proper light.
examples.zh: 工具棚没有窗户，「也」没有像样的照明。

words.enDefinition: either of the two categories (male or female) into which most organisms are divided

examples.en: The form asks for your sex, not your gender.
examples.zh: 表格填的是「生理性别」，不是社会性别。

examples.en: The vet can tell each duck's sex by its feathers.
examples.zh: 兽医能从羽毛分辨每只鸭子的「性别」。

words.enDefinition: human limb; commonly used to refer to a whole limb but technically only the part of the limb between the knee and ankle

examples.en: Rest the injured leg on the cushion until the swelling drops.
examples.zh: 把受伤的「腿」垫在靠垫上，等肿消下去。

examples.en: The table wobbles because its third leg is half a centimetre short.
examples.zh: 桌子晃悠，因为第三条「桌腿」短了半厘米。

words.enDefinition: counter where you can obtain food or drink

examples.en: The little bar by the station serves soup at noon.
examples.zh: 车站旁那家小「酒吧」中午还供应汤。

examples.en: She wipes down the bar before the evening musicians arrive.
examples.zh: 晚上「吧台」乐手到来之前，她先把台面擦净。

words.enDefinition: flexible container with a single opening

examples.en: Pack the sleeping bag last so the tent pegs stay handy.
examples.zh: 「睡袋」最后再打包，帐篷钉才随手可得。

examples.en: A bag of oranges appeared on our step from the neighbour's tree.
examples.zh: 邻居家树上的一「袋」橙子出现在了我们台阶上。

words.enDefinition: metal device shaped in such a way that when it is inserted into the appropriate lock the lock's mechanism can be rotated

examples.en: The spare key lives under the loose brick beside the step.
examples.zh: 备用「钥匙」藏在台阶旁那块松动的砖下。

examples.en: Each lodger has a key to both the front and shed door.
examples.zh: 每位房客都有前门和棚屋两把「钥匙」。

words.enDefinition: device for creating a current of air by movement of a surface or surfaces

examples.en: The ceiling fan keeps the kitchen bearable in August.
examples.zh: 八月里，吊「扇」让厨房还能待得住人。

examples.en: Grandmother waves a palm-leaf fan through every long sermon.
examples.zh: 每次长篇布道，奶奶都摇着蒲「扇」。

words.enDefinition: water frozen in the solid state

examples.en: Crack the ice on the water trough before the horses drink.
examples.zh: 马饮水前，先把水槽里的「冰」敲碎。

examples.en: Lemon ice from the market van is the children's summer ritual.
examples.zh: 市场餐车卖的柠檬「冰沙」是孩子们的夏日仪式。

words.enDefinition: the goal intended to be attained (and which is believed to be attainable)

examples.en: The club's aim is a library card for every child.
examples.zh: 俱乐部的「目标」是让每个孩子都有借书证。

examples.en: Check the aim of the sprinkler before you leave the garden.
examples.zh: 离开花园前，先看看洒水器的「喷水方向」对不对。

words.enDefinition: that which is deserved or owed

examples.en: Respect is due to every elder at the long table.
examples.zh: 长桌上每位长辈都「应受」尊重。

examples.en: The library dues are due before the end of March.
examples.zh: 图书馆「会费」须在三月底前缴清。

words.enDefinition: loud utterance; often in protest or opposition

examples.en: A cry from the gulls announced the fish cart.
examples.zh: 海鸥的「鸣叫」预示着鱼车来了。

examples.en: The baby's cry faded once the lullaby began.
examples.zh: 摇篮曲一响，宝宝的「哭声」就渐渐停了。

words.enDefinition: animal reproductive body consisting of an ovum or embryo together with nutritive and protective envelopes; especially the thin-shelled reproductive body laid by e.g. female birds

examples.en: Collect the eggs before the fox learns the henhouse routine.
examples.zh: 趁狐狸还没摸清鸡舍规律，快去捡「鸡蛋」。

examples.en: Beat one egg into the batter for a golden crust.
examples.zh: 在面糊里打一个「鸡蛋」，烤出来才有金黄脆皮。

words.enDefinition: equality of score in a contest

examples.en: The final ended in a tie, so both clubs kept the shield for a year.
examples.zh: 决赛「战成平局」，两家俱乐部各自保管盾杯一年。

examples.en: There was a tie for first place in the pumpkin contest.
examples.zh: 南瓜大赛第一名「不分伯仲」，两人并列。

words.enDefinition: free from water or moisture

examples.en: Hang the sheets in a dry, breezy spot, not the shade.
examples.zh: 床单要晾在「干燥」通风处，别背阴。

examples.en: The dry summer lowered the river past the second stone.
examples.zh: 「干旱的」夏天让河水退到了第二块石头以下。

words.enDefinition: soft greasy substance occurring in organic tissue and consisting of a mixture of lipids (mostly triglycerides)

examples.en: Skim the fat off the stock before it sets.
examples.zh: 高汤凝固前先撇去表面「油脂」。

examples.en: Seal fat renders into golden dripping for Sunday potatoes.
examples.zh: 板油熬出的金黄油脂，专门留给周日的土豆。

words.enDefinition: fixed charge for a privilege or for professional services

examples.en: The doctor's fee for a home visit is fixed by the clinic.
examples.zh: 上门诊疗的「费用」由诊所统一定价。

examples.en: There is no fee for using the village reading room.
examples.zh: 使用村阅览室不收任何「费用」。

words.enDefinition: commercially prepared mixture of dry ingredients

examples.en: The trail mix disappears before the first rest stop.
examples.zh: 那袋「混合」果仁在第一处休息点前就见了底。

examples.en: A mix of sun and cloud suits the hay drying.
examples.zh: 「晴云相间」的天气最适合晒制干草。

words.enDefinition: activities that are enjoyable or amusing

examples.en: The fun fair returns to the common every May.
examples.zh: 每年五月，充满「乐趣」的游乐场都会回到公共草地。

examples.en: Sorting the family photos turned into genuine fun all afternoon.
examples.zh: 整理家庭旧照，整个下午都成了一种纯粹的「乐趣」。

words.enDefinition: a problem or misfortune; also unwell (adjective)

examples.en: Gossip is an ill that spreads faster than any fire.
examples.zh: 流言是一种「弊病」，蔓延比火灾还快。

examples.en: The remedies of that era often did more ill than good.
examples.zh: 那个年代的疗法常常带来的「病害」多于益处。

words.enDefinition: not divisible by two; also strange or unexpected

examples.en: An odd number of chairs left one guest standing.
examples.zh: 椅子是「单数」，结果有位客人没座。

examples.en: It seemed odd that the baker closed on a Saturday.
examples.zh: 面包师「居然」周六歇业，实在「奇怪」。

words.enDefinition: experiencing or showing sorrow or unhappiness

examples.en: The sad song about the flooded valley still gets requests.
examples.zh: 那首描写河谷水患的「悲伤」歌曲至今仍有人点播。

examples.en: Sad news travels slowly by letter but arrives all the same.
examples.zh: 「坏消息」随信件传得慢，却终究会到。

words.enDefinition: an attempt to get something

examples.en: Our bid for the antique dresser stopped at forty pounds.
examples.zh: 那张古董五斗柜我们「出价」到四十镑就停了。

examples.en: The bakery made a bid to supply the school lunches.
examples.zh: 面包房「投标」争取为学校供应午餐。

words.enDefinition: an official rule that prohibits an activity or thing

examples.en: The council lifted its ban on barbecues after the rains.
examples.zh: 雨季过后，市政解除了烧烤「禁令」。

examples.en: There is a ban on parking beside the church gates.
examples.zh: 教堂大门旁「禁止」停车。

words.enDefinition: form of address for a woman

examples.en: Ms Turner keeps the parish records in the stone hall.
examples.zh: 「特纳女士」在石头大厅里保管着教区档案。

examples.en: Address the letter to Ms Patel, not the office.
examples.zh: 信请写给「帕特尔女士」，别寄到办公室。

words.enDefinition: the atmosphere and outer space as viewed from the earth

examples.en: The night sky above the vineyard shows three planets.
examples.zh: 葡萄园上空的「夜空」能看见三颗行星。

examples.en: The sky turned bruised purple an hour before the hail.
examples.zh: 冰雹来临前一小时，「天空」变成了青紫色。

words.enDefinition: an informal term for a father; probably derived from baby talk

examples.en: Dad still uses the same thermos he took to football matches.
examples.zh: 「爸爸」看球用的还是当年那只保温壶。

examples.en: My dad taught me to change a tyre on the lane.
examples.zh: 我「爸爸」在小路上教会了我换轮胎。

words.enDefinition: the sense organ for hearing and equilibrium

examples.en: The cat's ear twitches before the doorbell even rings.
examples.zh: 门铃还没响，猫的「耳朵」就先动了。

examples.en: Whisper the answer in my ear at the funeral tea.
examples.zh: 守灵茶会上，把答案「附耳」低声告诉我。

words.enDefinition: vehicle carrying many passengers; used for public transport

examples.en: The school bus leaves five minutes earlier in winter.
examples.zh: 冬季校「车」提早五分钟发车。

examples.en: Two bus routes serve the market square on Sundays.
examples.zh: 周日有两条「公交」线路经过集市广场。

words.enDefinition: either of two fleshy folds of tissue that surround the mouth and play a role in speaking

examples.en: She bit her lip during the whole penalty shootout.
examples.zh: 点球大战全程她都「咬着嘴唇」。

examples.en: A smile touched the corner of his lips at the joke.
examples.zh: 听到笑话，他的「嘴角」浮起一丝笑意。

words.enDefinition: diagrammatic representation of the earth's surface (or part of it)

examples.en: The walking map marks every stile and spring along the route.
examples.zh: 步行「地图」标出了沿线的每个跨梯和泉眼。

examples.en: Fold the map with the coastline facing out for quick checks.
examples.zh: 「地图」折时让海岸线朝外，方便随时查看。

words.enDefinition: quantity of money

examples.en: The sum of the repair quotes came to twice the budget.
examples.zh: 各项维修报价「加总」是预算的两倍。

examples.en: A tidy sum was raised for the church roof at the fete.
examples.zh: 游园会为教堂屋顶筹得了一笔可观的「款项」。

words.enDefinition: feline mammal usually having thick soft fur and no ability to roar: domestic cats; wildcats

examples.en: The farm cat earns her keep by clearing mice from the grain store.
examples.zh: 农场「猫」靠清剿粮仓老鼠来挣自己的口粮。

examples.en: Our cat sleeps through the vacuum cleaner's every pass.
examples.zh: 我们家「猫」在吸尘器来回轰鸣中照睡不误。

words.enDefinition: tavern consisting of a building with a bar and public rooms; often provides light meals

examples.en: The corner pub runs its quiz for locals every Thursday night.
examples.zh: 街角「酒馆」每周四晚为街坊举办问答赛。

examples.en: We sheltered from the rain in the warm pub by the bridge.
examples.zh: 我们在桥边暖和的「酒馆」里躲雨。

words.enDefinition: to repair or fasten something in place

examples.en: Dad fixed the dripping tap before the water bill arrived.
examples.zh: 水费单到之前，爸爸把滴水的龙头「修好」了。

examples.en: Fix the shelf to the studs, or your books will end up on the floor.
examples.zh: 书架要「固定」在墙筋上，不然书早晚掉一地。

words.enDefinition: the extreme end of something; especially something pointed

examples.en: The pencil's tip broke again in the sharpener.
examples.zh: 铅笔「笔尖」又在卷笔刀里断了。

examples.en: Write the boot size on the tip of the label, not the middle.
examples.zh: 鞋码写在标签「末端」，别写在中间。

words.enDefinition: conspicuous disparity or difference as between two figures

examples.en: There is a wide gap between the two quotes for the same job.
examples.zh: 同一份活儿，两份报价「差距」很大。

examples.en: Stuff the gap under the door before winter, or the draught will win.
examples.zh: 入冬前把门底的「缝隙」塞严，不然贼风占上风。

words.enDefinition: headdress that protects the head from bad weather; has shaped crown and usually a brim

examples.en: Grandfather's straw hat lives on the porch hook from May to September.
examples.zh: 从五月到九月，爷爷的草「帽」一直挂在门廊挂钩上。

examples.en: Hang your hat by the door so it dries before the evening.
examples.zh: 「帽子」进门就挂起来，晚上之前就能干。

words.enDefinition: an expression of greeting

examples.en: Hi, is this table free for the lunch rush?
examples.zh: 「嗨」，午餐高峰这张桌子空着吗？

examples.en: She waved and called a bright hi across the school yard.
examples.zh: 她挥手穿过校园，响亮地打了个「招呼」。

words.enDefinition: trap made of netting to catch fish or birds or insects

examples.en: Mend the fishing net before Friday's early tide.
examples.zh: 周五早潮前，先把渔「网」补好。

examples.en: Hang the goal net on the fence after training.
examples.zh: 训练结束后把球门「网」挂回围栏。

words.enDefinition: metal or earthenware cooking vessel that is usually round and deep; often has a handle and lid

examples.en: The jam pot needs a wider lid than this old one.
examples.zh: 果酱「锅」需要比这个旧盖更宽的盖子。

examples.en: A pot of mint tea steamed on the low table.
examples.zh: 矮桌上一「壶」薄荷茶冒着热气。

words.enDefinition: tight-fitting headdress

examples.en: Wear your wool cap on the boat; the wind bites.
examples.zh: 船上风刺骨，戴上你的羊毛「帽」。

examples.en: The bottle cap twists off without a bottle opener.
examples.zh: 这种瓶「盖」不用开瓶器就能拧开。

words.enDefinition: be obliged to pay or repay

examples.en: We owe the tree surgeon two visits' worth of cake.
examples.zh: 修剪树木师傅来过两次，我们欠他两份蛋糕的「人情」。

examples.en: You owe the library only the replacement cost, not a fine.
examples.zh: 你只需「赔」图书馆书价，不必另交罚款。

words.enDefinition: an indentation of a shoreline larger than a cove but smaller than a gulf

examples.en: The fishing boats shelter in the bay when the south wind rises.
examples.zh: 南风一起，渔船便躲进「海湾」避风。

examples.en: A quiet bay between the cliffs makes the best swimming spot.
examples.zh: 悬崖间那处安静的「小湾」是最佳游泳地。

words.enDefinition: covered with or containing water

examples.en: Keep the wet towels off the wooden bench.
examples.zh: 别把「湿」毛巾放在木长凳上。

examples.en: The grass was still wet from last night's dew.
examples.zh: 草地还带着昨夜的露水，「湿漉漉的」。

words.enDefinition: nonfunctional replica of something else (frequently used as a modifier)

examples.en: The toy chest overflows after every family birthday.
examples.zh: 每次家庭生日会后，「玩具」箱都会爆满。

examples.en: He donates his old toy cars to the hospital ward.
examples.zh: 他把旧「玩具」车捐给了医院病房。

words.enDefinition: to break up and move earth; to search or investigate

examples.en: Start the dig for the fence posts along the chalk line.
examples.zh: 沿粉线开始「挖」栅栏桩的坑。

examples.en: The children dug a rabbit-sized hole at the back of the sandpit.
examples.zh: 孩子们在沙坑后面「挖」了个兔子大小的洞。

words.enDefinition: cooking utensil consisting of a wide metal vessel

examples.en: Season the iron pan with oil after every wash.
examples.zh: 每次清洗后给铁「锅」抹油养护。

examples.en: The baking pan warped in the hot oven, so the cake leaned.
examples.zh: 烤「盘」在热烤箱里变了形，蛋糕都歪了。

words.enDefinition: sweet drink containing carbonated water and flavoring

examples.en: Two bottles of pop and a bag of crisps for the picnic.
examples.zh: 野餐带两瓶「汽水」和一包薯片。

examples.en: The corner shop sells pop in returnable glass bottles.
examples.zh: 街角小店卖可回收玻璃瓶装的「碳酸饮料」。

words.enDefinition: roused to anger

examples.en: Grandmother was mad about hydrangeas, planting them in every corner.
examples.zh: 奶奶「痴迷于」绣球花，每个角落都种上了。

examples.en: Don't be mad at the wind; it scatters what we planted.
examples.zh: 别「生」风的「气」，是我们种下的东西被吹散了。

words.enDefinition: either side of the body below the waist and above the thigh

examples.en: Grandfather's new hip means he dances at every wedding again.
examples.zh: 换了新的「髋关节」，爷爷又能逢婚礼必跳舞了。

examples.en: She carried the toddler on her hip all round the market.
examples.zh: 她把孩子「挎在胯上」逛遍了集市。

words.enDefinition: the act of gambling

examples.en: I lost a small bet on the derby this year.
examples.zh: 今年德比马赛我「打赌」输了点小钱。

examples.en: It's a safe bet the ferry will be late in fog.
examples.zh: 十有「八九」，起雾轮渡准晚点。

words.enDefinition: with the skin rubbed or scraped off; uncooked or in a natural, unprocessed state

examples.en: His hands were raw after a day of pulling ropes in the frost.
examples.zh: 冰天雪地拉了一天缆绳，他的手都「磨破了」。

examples.en: Raw milk from the farm needs boiling before the baby's bottle.
examples.zh: 农场的「生」奶在冲婴儿奶瓶前必须煮沸。

words.enDefinition: the emotion of great happiness

examples.en: The first strawberry of June is pure joy.
examples.zh: 六月的第一颗草莓纯粹是一种「喜悦」。

examples.en: She takes great joy in teaching the neighbour's children to knit.
examples.zh: 她从教邻居孩子织毛线中获得极大「乐趣」。

words.enDefinition: small metal plate that attaches to the toe or heel of a shoe (as in tap dancing)

examples.en: Turn the garden tap off properly or the hose will hiss all night.
examples.zh: 花园「水龙头」要关严，不然水管整夜嘶嘶漏。

examples.en: A gentle tap on the jar lid loosens the vacuum seal.
examples.zh: 在罐盖上轻轻一「敲」，真空封口就松了。

words.enDefinition: relieve from

examples.en: Get rid of the wasp nest before the picnic season.
examples.zh: 野餐季到来前，把马蜂窝「除掉」。

examples.en: The new filter finally rid the pond of its green tint.
examples.zh: 新「过滤器」终于让池塘摆脱了那层绿色。

words.enDefinition: female of domestic cattle: "`moo-cow' is a child's term"

examples.en: The grey cow waits by the gate at milking time.
examples.zh: 挤奶时间一到，那头灰「牛」就在门口等候。

examples.en: Dad coaxes the nervous cow into the trailer with a bucket of feed.
examples.zh: 爸爸用一桶饲料哄那头胆小的「母牛」上拖车。

words.enDefinition: writing implement with a point from which ink flows

examples.en: The good fountain pen writes better on the church register paper.
examples.zh: 这支好钢「笔」在教堂登记簿纸上写起来更顺。

examples.en: Keep a pen chained to the counter for the delivery book.
examples.zh: 柜台上用链子拴一支「笔」，专供签收簿用。

words.enDefinition: (Great Britain) a closed railroad car that carries baggage or freight

examples.en: The bakery van delivers to the island twice a week.
examples.zh: 面包房「货车」每周两次送货上岛。

examples.en: Reverse the van slowly; the yard gate is barely wider than the mirrors.
examples.zh: 「面包车」倒车要慢，院子门只比后视镜宽一点点。

words.enDefinition: domesticated animal kept for companionship or amusement

examples.en: Register your pet at the clinic before the summer travel rush.
examples.zh: 夏季出行高峰前，先带「宠物」到诊所登记。

examples.en: The hotel allows one small pet per room with a deposit.
examples.zh: 交押金后，每间房可携带一只小型「宠物」。

words.enDefinition: casual expression used when leaving; goodbye

examples.en: She waved bye to her cousins from the departing train.
examples.zh: 火车开动时，她向表亲们挥手道「别」。

examples.en: Say bye to the hosts before you slip out early.
examples.zh: 提早离席前，记得向主人道声「再见」。

words.enDefinition: to cook food in hot oil or fat

examples.en: Fry the onions until they turn golden, not brown.
examples.zh: 洋葱要「煎」到金黄，别炒过头。

examples.en: Weekend fry-ups in the pan are a family tradition.
examples.zh: 周末「煎」一大盘早餐是家里的传统。

words.enDefinition: to have the size or shape needed for a person, object, or space

examples.en: These winter boots fit over two pairs of socks.
examples.zh: 这双冬靴「装得下」两双袜子，正合适。

examples.en: The last shelf fits exactly between the window and the radiator.
examples.zh: 最后那层搁板「正好」卡在窗户与暖气片之间。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement of objects or people side by side in a line

examples.en: Plant the onion row twelve centimetres apart, the farmer advised.
examples.zh: 农夫建议洋葱「行」距保持十二厘米。

examples.en: We took the front row of the school concert on folding chairs.
examples.zh: 我们自带折椅，坐了学校音乐会「第一排」。

words.enDefinition: informal terms for a mother

examples.en: Mom keeps the spare keys in the cookie jar on the top shelf.
examples.zh: 「妈妈」把备用钥匙藏在最上层那罐饼干里。

examples.en: Ask mom before you borrow her good sewing scissors.
examples.zh: 拿妈妈「好缝纫剪刀」前，先征得「妈妈」同意。

words.enDefinition: the act of rubbing or wiping

examples.en: Rub the cutting board with lemon to lift the onion smell.
examples.zh: 用柠檬「擦」砧板，去除洋葱味。

examples.en: A brisk rub with a towel warms cold hands quickly.
examples.zh: 用毛巾使劲「搓」几下，冻僵的手很快就暖了。

words.enDefinition: silvery malleable metallic element that resists corrosion; used in many alloys and to coat other metals to prevent corrosion; obtained chiefly from cassiterite where it occurs as tin oxide
