examples.en: The biscuit tin is empty again before the weekend.
examples.zh: 还没到周末，饼干「罐」又空了。

examples.en: A tin of white paint touched up the garden bench.
examples.zh: 一「罐」白漆把花园长椅修补一新。

words.enDefinition: a farm animal kept for its meat; also a crude block of iron from a smelter

examples.en: The pig pen is mucked out every Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 「猪圈」每周六早上都要清粪。

examples.en: She saved coins in a pottery pig with a smiling face.
examples.zh: 她把硬币存进一只笑脸陶「猪」存钱罐。

words.enDefinition: usually large hard-shelled seed

examples.en: Crack each nut on the stone step, not the good table.
examples.zh: 坚果要在石阶上「敲开」，别在好桌上。

examples.en: The old bench is held together by one stubborn nut.
examples.zh: 旧长椅全靠一颗「螺母」紧固着。

words.enDefinition: one of the digits of the foot

examples.en: Wiggle each toe before you lace the ski boots.
examples.zh: 系滑雪靴前，先活动每根「脚趾」。

examples.en: The hammock's toe end nearly touches the rose bush.
examples.zh: 吊床的「一端」几乎碰到玫瑰丛。

words.enDefinition: water soaked soil; soft wet earth

examples.en: Wipe the mud off the dog's paws before the hallway rug.
examples.zh: 进门擦掉狗狗爪子上的「泥」，别弄脏门厅地毯。

examples.en: The lane turns to thick mud after every spring rain.
examples.zh: 每场春雨过后，小路都变成厚厚的「泥浆」。

words.enDefinition: a small round mark or spot

examples.en: Mark the spring on the map with a red dot.
examples.zh: 用红色「圆点」在地图上标出泉眼位置。

examples.en: The i in her signature carries a perfect dot.
examples.zh: 她签名中字母 i 上的「点」打得又圆又正。

words.enDefinition: movable top or cover (hinged or separate) for closing the opening at the top of a box, chest, jar, pan, etc.

examples.en: The jar lid pops when the seal is perfect.
examples.zh: 封得好时，罐「盖」会砰地一声弹响。

examples.en: Keep the saucepan lid on while the rice finishes.
examples.zh: 米饭焖好前，锅「盖」别揭开。

words.enDefinition: the dressed hairy coat of a mammal

examples.en: The dog's winter fur thickens by the end of November.
examples.zh: 狗的冬季「皮毛」到十一月底就长厚了。

examples.en: A fur collar keeps the old coat smart for church.
examples.zh: 一条「毛皮」领子让旧大衣做礼拜穿时依旧体面。

words.enDefinition: take something away by force or without the consent of the owner

examples.en: Thieves tried to rob the ticket office during the festival.
examples.zh: 节庆期间，窃贼企图「抢劫」售票处。

examples.en: They robbed the orchard of most of its plums overnight.
examples.zh: 一夜之间，果园的李子几乎被「抢」了个精光。

words.enDefinition: liquid used for printing or writing or drawing

examples.en: The printer ran out of blue ink before the invitations finished.
examples.zh: 请柬还没印完，蓝色「墨水」就耗尽了。

examples.en: Grandfather signs his letters in fountain ink, never pencil.
examples.zh: 爷爷写信从来用钢笔「墨水」，绝不用铅笔。

words.enDefinition: container; usually has a lid

examples.en: Wheel the recycling bin to the kerb before seven.
examples.zh: 七点前把回收「垃圾桶」推到路边。

examples.en: Keep a lidded bin by the potting bench for the trimming waste.
examples.zh: 盆栽台旁放个带盖「料桶」，装修剪下来的枝叶。

words.enDefinition: preserve of crushed fruit

examples.en: Grandmother's plum jam sets firm without any pectin.
examples.zh: 奶奶的李子「果酱」不加果胶也能凝固。

examples.en: A jam sandwich after school is still the best reward.
examples.zh: 放学后来一份「果酱」三明治，仍是最棒的犒赏。

words.enDefinition: informal word for mother

examples.en: Mum locks the greenhouse before the first frost every year.
examples.zh: 每年头霜之前，「妈妈」都会锁好温室。

examples.en: My mum grows the tallest sunflowers on the whole street.
examples.zh: 我「妈妈」种的向日葵是全街最高的。

words.enDefinition: public promotion of some product or service

examples.en: The bakery's little ad in the parish newsletter works wonders.
examples.zh: 面包房在教区通讯上登的那则小「广告」效果惊人。

examples.en: Design the ad so the phone number is easy to read.
examples.zh: 「广告」设计要让电话号码一目了然。

words.enDefinition: an intricate network suggesting something that was formed by weaving or interweaving

examples.en: A dew-covered web spans the gateposts each autumn morning.
examples.zh: 每个秋晨，门柱之间都张着沾满露水的蜘蛛「网」。

examples.en: The studio posts her tapestries on its web page.
examples.zh: 工作室在「网页」上展示她的挂毯。

words.enDefinition: an acute febrile highly contagious viral disease

examples.en: The winter flu spread through the whole choir in ten days.
examples.zh: 十天之内，冬季「流感」传遍了整个合唱团。

examples.en: Rest and hot soup beat the flu faster than tablets.
examples.zh: 对付「流感」，休息加热汤比药片更管用。

words.enDefinition: fasten by sewing; do needlework

examples.en: Sew the buttons on with double thread, like the uniforms.
examples.zh: 像制服那样，用双线「缝」纽扣。

examples.en: Grandmother sews the altar cloths by hand every spring.
examples.zh: 每年春天，奶奶都亲手「缝制」祭坛布。

words.enDefinition: full of or showing high-spirited merriment

examples.en: The old songbook calls the meadow walk a gay morning ramble.
examples.zh: 那本老歌集把草地漫步称作「欢快的」清晨漫游。

examples.en: Laughter was gay and loud at the harvest table.
examples.zh: 丰收餐桌上，笑声「欢快」而爽朗。

words.enDefinition: sign of assent or salutation or command

examples.en: A single nod settled the argument over the shed paint.
examples.zh: 关于棚屋油漆颜色的争执，一个「点头」便尘埃落定。

examples.en: Give me a nod when the kettle is ready.
examples.zh: 水开了就向我「点」一下「头」。

words.enDefinition: period marked by distinctive character or reckoned from a fixed point or event

examples.en: The brick water tower dates from the era of steam trains.
examples.zh: 那座砖砌水塔是「蒸汽火车时代」的产物。

examples.en: In an era of cellphones, the semaphore flags look quaint.
examples.zh: 在「手机时代」，信号旗显得颇为古雅。

words.enDefinition: sizeable hole (usually in the ground)

examples.en: The old chalk pit fills with frogspawn every March.
examples.zh: 每年三月，老「白垩坑」里便满是蛙卵。

examples.en: Campers dug a fire pit well away from the tents.
examples.zh: 野营的人把「火坑」挖在远离帐篷的地方。

words.enDefinition: narrow wood or metal or plastic runners used in pairs for gliding over snow

examples.en: Wax the ski bases the night before the trail opens.
examples.zh: 越野「雪板」开板前夜要打蜡。

examples.en: The beginners' ski class meets at the nursery slope.
examples.zh: 初学者「滑雪」课在缓坡集合。

words.enDefinition: an airplane powered by one or more jet engines

examples.en: The morning jet to the capital overflies our valley.
examples.zh: 清晨飞往首都的「喷气式飞机」从我们山谷上空掠过。

examples.en: The airfield's last jet lands long after the market closes.
examples.zh: 机场末班「喷气式客机」降落时，集市早已收摊。

words.enDefinition: the upper side of the thighs of a seated person

examples.en: The cat curls up on Grandfather's lap during the news.
examples.zh: 新闻时间，猫总蜷在爷爷「膝上」。

examples.en: She finished the final lap of the pool race seconds ahead.
examples.zh: 泳赛最后一「圈」，她领先几秒触壁。

words.enDefinition: nocturnal mouselike mammal with forelimbs modified to form membranous wings and anatomical adaptations for echolocation by which they navigate

examples.en: A bat patrols the garden every dusk, clearing the midges.
examples.zh: 每天黄昏都有「蝙蝠」在花园上空巡逻，清剿蠓虫。

examples.en: The cricket bat waits in the shed until the first dry Saturday.
examples.zh: 板球「棒」在棚子里候着，直到第一个晴朗的周六。

words.enDefinition: select as an alternative over another

examples.en: New tenants may opt for the furnished or empty flat.
examples.zh: 新房客可以「选择」带家具或不带家具的公寓。

examples.en: More commuters opt to cycle since the shelter opened.
examples.zh: 「自」车棚启用后，更多通勤者「选择」骑车。

words.enDefinition: a narrow beam of light or heat; a line radiating from a centre

examples.en: A single ray of sun crossed the sickroom floor at noon.
examples.zh: 一「道」阳光斜落在病房地板上。

examples.en: Heat rays rise off the flagstones through every August afternoon.
examples.zh: 整个八月，石板上都蒸腾着灼人的「热浪」。

words.enDefinition: an actor's line that immediately precedes and serves as a reminder for some action or speech

examples.en: The stage manager gives the lighting cue from the wings.
examples.zh: 舞台监督在侧幕给出灯光「提示」。

examples.en: Taking your cue from the conductor keeps the choir together.
examples.zh: 跟随指挥的「提示」，合唱团才能整齐合一。

words.enDefinition: the basic unit of money in Japan; equal to 100 sen

examples.en: The souvenir stand quotes prices in yen and euro.
examples.zh: 纪念品摊的价签同时标着「日元」和欧元。

examples.en: She saved yen for two years before the Tokyo trip.
examples.zh: 东京之行前，她攒了两年「日元」。

words.enDefinition: an informal greeting or interjection to get attention

examples.en: Hey, your goat is in my vegetable bed again!
examples.zh: 「嘿」，你的山羊又进我的菜地了！

examples.en: The coach began every drill with a loud hey to gather us.
examples.zh: 教练每节训练课都用一声响亮的「喂」把我们聚拢。

words.enDefinition: uncomplimentary terms for a policeman

examples.en: The traffic cop waved the hearse through the crowded junction.
examples.zh: 交通「警察」挥手让灵车通过了拥挤的路口。

examples.en: A friendly cop helped us carry the stall boards at closing.
examples.zh: 收摊时，一位友善的「警官」帮我们抬挡板。

words.enDefinition: to take legal action against someone

examples.en: The allotment group will sue the builder over the blocked ditch.
examples.zh: 因排水沟被堵，园圃小组将「起诉」建筑商。

examples.en: You cannot sue a neighbour over leaves falling on your lawn.
examples.zh: 邻居树叶落进你家院子，是不能「告」的。

words.enDefinition: any of various long-tailed rodents similar to but larger than a mouse

examples.en: A rat slipped along the granary wall at dusk.
examples.zh: 黄昏时分，一只「老鼠」沿着谷仓墙根溜过。

examples.en: The terrier earns her biscuits by hunting rats in the rickyard.
examples.zh: 那只梗犬在垛场捕「鼠」，赚得自己的饼干。

words.enDefinition: case for containing a set of articles

examples.en: Pack the first aid kit into the boot before the drive.
examples.zh: 出发前把急救「包」放进后备箱。

examples.en: The repair kit lives in the drawer under the stairs.
examples.zh: 修理「工具箱」放在楼梯下的抽屉里。

words.enDefinition: estrangement from god

examples.en: Wasting good bread was counted a sin in Grandmother's house.
examples.zh: 在奶奶家，糟蹋好面包被视为一种「罪过」。

examples.en: The sermon urges small kindnesses instead of dwelling on sin.
examples.zh: 布道劝人多行小善，别总盯着「罪」不放。

words.enDefinition: segment of the trunk of a tree when stripped of branches

examples.en: The oak log splits better after two weeks of drying.
examples.zh: 橡木「原木」晾上两周会更好劈。

examples.en: Log fires crackle cheerfully in the inn's stone hearth.
examples.zh: 「木柴」在旅社石砌炉膛里欢快地噼啪作响。

words.enDefinition: call upon in supplication; entreat

examples.en: The rescued pup begs at the table until Grandfather gives in.
examples.zh: 获救的小狗在桌边「讨食」，直到爷爷让步。

examples.en: She begged the ferryman to wait two minutes for the lost oarsman.
examples.zh: 她「央求」船夫等两分钟，好让落桨的人赶回来。

words.enDefinition: an opening made forcibly as by pulling apart

examples.en: There's a rip in the tarpaulin where the branch fell.
examples.zh: 树枝砸落处，防水布「撕裂」了一道口子。

examples.en: A rip along the hem shows where the dress caught on the gate.
examples.zh: 裙摆的「裂口」显示它在门上刮了一下。

words.enDefinition: a large tree with acorns, or its hard wood used for furniture

examples.en: The oak at the crossroads is older than the parish register.
examples.zh: 路口那棵「橡树」比教区登记册还要年长。

examples.en: The door panels are solid oak from the same wood as the pews.
examples.zh: 门板是实心「橡木」，与长椅出自同一木料。

words.enDefinition: number of sheets of paper fastened together along one edge

examples.en: Write the order on the pad by the phone.
examples.zh: 把订单写在电话旁的「便签本」上。

examples.en: A knee pad saves the trousers during the weeding.
examples.zh: 除草时垫上护「膝垫」，裤子就保住了。

words.enDefinition: hotel providing overnight lodging for travelers

examples.en: The harbour inn serves stew until nine every evening.
examples.zh: 港口「客栈」每晚供应炖菜到九点。

examples.en: We booked two rooms at the coaching inn for the reunion.
examples.zh: 团聚周我们在那家老「旅店」订了两间房。

words.enDefinition: tight or amorous embrace

examples.en: A warm hug from Aunt Bess ended the long journey.
examples.zh: 贝丝姨妈一个温暖的「拥抱」为漫长旅途收了尾。

examples.en: Give your brother a hug before he boards the ferry.
examples.zh: 弟弟登船前，去「抱抱」他吧。
